ko.title: 북미 무역협정이 임박했다: USMCA 검토가 자동차, 농업, 물가에 미치는 의미

segments.src: The United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement, usually shortened to USMCA, is the rulebook behind most of the goods that cross North American borders.
segments.tr: 보통 USMCA로 줄여 불리는 미국-멕시코-캐나다 협정은 북미 국경을 넘나드는 대부분의 상품 뒤에 있는 규칙 북입니다.

segments.src: It covers everything from pickup trucks and auto parts to dairy, corn, produce and machinery.
segments.tr: 이 협정은 픽업트럭과 자동차 부품부터 유제품, 옥수수, 농산물, 기계류에 이르기까지 모든 것을 다룹니다.

segments.src: Because the agreement includes a scheduled review, businesses, farmers and shoppers have all been paying close attention to how the three governments handle it.
segments.tr: 이 협정에는 정기 검토 일정이 포함되어 있기 때문에 기업, 농부, 쇼핑객 모두 세 정부가 이를 어떻게 처리하는지 예의주시해 왔습니다.

segments.src: This explainer covers what the review is, what each country wants, and how the outcome could reach car lots, grocery aisles and factory floors.
segments.tr: 이 해설서는 검토가 무엇인지, 각국이 원하는 것이 무엇인지, 그리고 그 결과가 자동차 전시장, 식료품 통로, 공장 바닥에 어떻게 미칠 수 있는지를 다룹니다.

segments.src: Negotiations change quickly, so check current reporting from reliable news outlets for the latest status.
segments.tr: 협상은 빠르게 변하므로 최신 상태는 신뢰할 수 있는 뉴스 매체의 현재 보도를 확인하세요.

segments.src: ## What Is the USMCA Review?
segments.tr: ## USMCA 검토란 무엇인가요?

segments.src: The USMCA took effect on July 1, 2020, replacing the 1994 North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA).
segments.tr: USMCA는 2020년 7월 1일에 발효되어 1994년 북미자유무역협정(NAFTA)을 대체했습니다.

segments.src: The text includes a "joint review" at the six-year mark, in 2026.
segments.tr: 본문에는 6년 차인 2026년에 "공동 검토"가 포함되어 있습니다.

segments.src: At that point each country is asked to confirm in writing whether it wants to extend the agreement's term.
segments.tr: 이 시점에서 각국은 협정의 기한을 연장할지 여부를 서면으로 확인하도록 요청받습니다.

segments.src: The mechanics matter more than the headlines suggest:
segments.tr: 메커니즘은 헤드라인이 시사하는 것보다 더 중요합니다:

segments.src: - **If all three countries confirm,** the agreement's term is extended for another 16 years.
segments.tr: - **세 국가 모두 확인하는 경우,** 협정의 기한이 또 다른 16년 동안 연장됩니다.

segments.src: - **If any country does not confirm,** the three move to annual joint reviews. The agreement does not end automatically, but it would keep a 2036 expiration date unless the parties later agree to extend it.
segments.tr: - **어느 국가라도 확인하지 않는 경우,** 세 국가는 매년 공동 검토로 전환합니다. 협정이 자동으로 종료되지는 않지만, 당사자들이 나중에 연장하기로 합의하지 않는 한 2036년 만료일이 유지됩니다.

segments.src: - **Withdrawal is a separate step.** Any country can leave with six months' written notice, but that is a different process from the review.
segments.tr: - **탈퇴는 별도의 단계입니다.** 어느 국가나 6개월 전에 서면 통지하고 떠날 수 있지만, 이는 검토와는 다른 프로세스입니다.

segments.src: In short, the review is a checkpoint and a bargaining moment, not a cliff.
segments.tr: 요컨대, 검토는 절벽이 아니라 체크포인트이자 협상의 순간입니다.

segments.src: Still, uncertainty alone can change how companies plan.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 불확실성 그 자체만으로도 기업의 계획 수립 방식을 바꿀 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why So Much Is at Stake
segments.tr: ## 왜 그토록 많은 것이 걸려 있는가

segments.src: North America is one of the most integrated trading regions in the world.
segments.tr: 북미는 세계에서 가장 통합된 무역 지역 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: The United States, Canada and Mexico trade well over a trillion dollars in goods with one another each year, and Canada and Mexico rank among the largest export markets for American producers.
segments.tr: 미국, 캐나다, 멕시코는 매년 서로 1조 달러가 넘는 상품을 무역하며, 캐나다와 멕시코는 미국 생산자들에게 가장 큰 수출 시장 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: Many products cross borders several times during manufacturing before they reach a customer.
segments.tr: 많은 제품이 고객에게 도달하기 전에 제조 과정에서 국경을 여러 번 넘습니다.

segments.src: That integration is why even small rule changes can ripple outward.
segments.tr: 그러한 통합 때문에 작은 규칙 변경조차도 파급 효과를 낼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A tariff or a new paperwork requirement at one border can add cost to a product assembled across all three countries.
segments.tr: 한 국경에서의 관세 또는 새로운 서류 요구 사항은 세 국가 모두에서 조립된 제품에 비용을 추가할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Autos: The Biggest Piece of the Puzzle
segments.tr: ## 자동차: 퍼즐의 가장 큰 조각

segments.src: The auto sector is the most closely watched part of the review.
segments.tr: 자동차 부문은 검토에서 가장 면밀히 모니터링되는 부분입니다.

segments.src: Vehicles and parts are made in a tightly linked supply chain, with engines, transmissions, wiring, seats and electronics moving back and forth across borders.
segments.tr: 차량과 부품은 긴밀하게 연결된 공급망에서 만들어지며, 엔진, 변속기, 배선, 시트, 전자기기가 국경을 넘나들며 이동합니다.

segments.src: Key issues include:
segments.tr: 주요 이슈는 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Rules of origin.** Under current rules, a vehicle generally must have 75% of its content from North America to qualify for duty-free treatment. A share of the work must also be done by workers earning at least $16 an hour. Governments may seek to raise these thresholds or add requirements for specific components such as steel, aluminum and batteries.
segments.tr: - **원산지 규정.** 현재 규정에 따르면, 차량은 관세 면제 혜택을 받기 위해 일반적으로 북미산 콘텐츠가 75%여야 합니다. 또한 작업의 일정 비율은 시간당 최소 16달러를 받는 노동자에 의해 수행되어야 합니다. 정부는 이러한 기준을 높이거나 강철, 알루미늄, 배터리와 같은 특정 부품에 대한 요구 사항을 추가할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Non-North American content.** Washington has voiced concern about parts and materials from outside the region, especially from China, entering the supply chain through Mexico or Canada.
segments.tr: - **비북미산 콘텐츠.** 워싱턴은 멕시코나 캐나다를 통해 공급망에 유입되는 역외 지역, 특히 중국산 부품 및 자재에 대해 우려를 표명했습니다.

segments.src: - **Tariffs outside the agreement.** Separate U.S. tariffs on autos, auto parts, steel and aluminum have complicated the picture. Automakers want clarity on how those measures interact with USMCA benefits.
segments.tr: - **협정 외 관세.** 자동차, 자동차 부품, 철강 및 알루미늄에 대한 미국의 별도 관세가 상황을 복잡하게 만들었습니다. 자동차 제조업체들은 이러한 조치가 USMCA 혜택과 어떻게 상호 작용하는지에 대한 명확성을 원합니다.

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Automakers can absorb some added costs, pass them to buyers, or reshuffle production.
segments.tr: **가격에 미칠 수 있는 영향:** 자동차 제조업체는 추가 비용을 일부 흡수하거나, 구매자에게 전가하거나, 생산을 재조정할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Any of those choices can affect sticker prices, trim availability and used-car values.
segments.tr: 이러한 선택 중 어떤 것이든 스티커 가격, 트림 가용성, 중고차 가치에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Analysts often note that costs tied to tariffs or stricter origin rules tend to show up gradually rather than all at once.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 관세나 엄격한 원산지 규정과 관련된 비용이 한 번에 나타나기보다는 점진적으로 나타나는 경향이 있다고 종종 지적합니다.

segments.src: ## Farms and Groceries
segments.tr: ## 농장과 식료품

segments.src: Agriculture is another major area.
segments.tr: 농업은 또 다른 주요 분야입니다.

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: farmers sell large volumes of corn, soybeans, pork, beef, poultry and dairy to Mexico and Canada, while Americans buy fresh fruit, vegetables, avocados, tomatoes, beer and beef from them in return.
segments.tr: 농부들은 멕시코와 캐나다에 대량의 옥수수, 대두, 돼지고기, 소고기, 가금류, 유제품을 판매하고, 미국인들은 그 대가로 신선한 과일, 채소, 아보카도, 토마토, 맥주, 소고기를 구매합니다.

segments.src: Points of friction include:
segments.tr: 마찰 지점은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Dairy.** U.S. producers have long argued that Canada's supply-management system limits their access to its market. Canada has defended that system as important to its own farmers.
segments.tr: - **유제품.** 미국 생산자들은 캐나다의 공급 관리 시스템이 자사 시장 접근을 제한한다고 오랫동안 주장해 왔습니다. 캐나다는 그 시스템이 자국 농부들에게 중요하다고 방어해 왔습니다.

segments.src: - **Biotech corn.** Mexico's policies on genetically engineered corn have been a flashpoint, and a dispute panel previously ruled on part of that issue.
segments.tr: - **생명공학 옥수수.** 멕시코의 유전자 변형 옥수수 정책은 뇌관이었으며, 분쟁 패널이 이 문제의 일부에 대해 이전에 판결을 내린 바 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Seasonal produce.** Growers in some U.S. states say imports compete with them during certain months, while shoppers rely on those imports for year-round supply.
segments.tr: - **계절 농산물.** 일부 미국의 재배자들은 수입품이 특정 달에 자신들과 경쟁한다고 말하는 반면, 쇼핑객들은 연중 공급을 위해 이러한 수입품에 의존합니다.

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Because many fruits and vegetables are imported during the winter, higher tariffs or trade barriers could raise grocery costs or reduce choice in some categories.
segments.tr: **가격에 미칠 수 있는 영향:** 많은 과일과 채소가 겨울 동안 수입되기 때문에, 더 높은 관세나 무역 장벽은 식료품 비용을 높이거나 일부 범주에서 선택을 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: On the export side, farmers worry that retaliation by trading partners could lower demand for U.S.
segments.tr: 수출 측면에서, 농부들은 무역 파트너의 보복이 미국의 수요를 낮출 수 있다고 우려합니다.

segments.src: crops and livestock.
segments.tr: 작물과 가축.

segments.src: ## Jobs and Factories
segments.tr: ## 일자리와 공장

segments.src: Manufacturing employment is a central argument on every side.
segments.tr: 제조업 고용은 모든 측면에서 핵심적인 논쟁입니다.

segments.src: Supporters of tighter rules say stronger requirements can bring production and jobs to the United States and raise wages.
segments.tr: 더 엄격한 규칙을 지지하는 사람들은 더 강력한 요구 사항이 생산과 일자리를 미국으로 가져오고 임금을 높일 수 있다고 말합니다.

segments.src: Others caution that making cross-border supply chains more costly could reduce competitiveness against producers in Asia and Europe and put existing jobs at risk.
segments.tr: 다른 이들은 국경 간 공급망을 더 비용이 많이 들게 만드는 것이 아시아와 유럽의 생산자에 대한 경쟁력을 떨어뜨리고 기존 일자리를 위험에 빠뜨릴 수 있다고 경고합니다.

segments.src: Mexico has an interest in keeping its position as a major manufacturing hub and in attracting investment.
segments.tr: 멕시코는 주요 제조업 허브로서의 입지를 유지하고 투자를 유치하는 데 관심이 있습니다.

segments.src: Canada, which sends the large majority of its exports south, depends heavily on predictable access to the U.S.
segments.tr: 수출의 대다수를 남쪽으로 보내는 캐나다는 미국의 예측 가능한 접근에 크게 의존합니다.

segments.src: market.
segments.tr: 시장.

segments.src: For many communities, a single plant can be a main employer, so decisions about where to invest are watched closely.
segments.tr: 많은 커뮤니티에서 단일 공장이 주요 고용주가 될 수 있으므로 투자처에 대한 결정이 면밀히 관찰됩니다.

segments.src: ## Other Topics on the Table
segments.tr: ## 테이블 위의 다른 주제들

segments.src: The review is not limited to cars and crops.
segments.tr: 검토는 자동차와 농산물에 국한되지 않습니다.

segments.src: Other issues that have come up include:
segments.tr: 제기된 다른 이슈들은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Energy policy,** including the role of state-owned energy companies in Mexico.
segments.tr: - **에너지 정책,** 멕시코의 국영 에너지 기업의 역할을 포함합니다.

segments.src: - **Digital trade and online services,** including taxes and data rules.
segments.tr: - **디지털 무역 및 온라인 서비스,** 세금 및 데이터 규칙을 포함합니다.

segments.src: - **Labor standards,** such as enforcement of workers' rights in Mexican facilities.
segments.tr: - **노동 기준,** 멕시코 시설에서의 노동자 권리 집행 등.

segments.src: - **Dispute settlement,** and whether the process for resolving trade disagreements is fast and effective enough.
segments.tr: - **분쟁 해결,** 그리고 무역 불일치를 해결하기 위한 프로세스가 충분히 빠르고 효과적인지 여부.

segments.src: - **Economic security,** including how to handle investment and imports from non-member countries.
segments.tr: - **경제 안보,** 비회원국의 투자 및 수입을 처리하는 방법을 포함합니다.

segments.src: ## Why Businesses Are Bracing for Uncertainty
segments.tr: ## 기업들이 불확실성에 대비하는 이유

segments.src: Companies make decisions years in advance.
segments.tr: 기업들은 몇 년 앞서 결정을 내립니다.

segments.src: Building or expanding a plant, signing supplier contracts and setting vehicle prices all depend on a stable set of rules.
segments.tr: 공장을 짓거나 확장하고, 공급업체 계약을 체결하고, 차량 가격을 설정하는 것은 모두 안정적인 규칙 세트에 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: When the rules might change, firms tend to respond in familiar ways:
segments.tr: 규칙이 변경될 수 있을 때, 기업들은 익숙한 방식으로 대응하는 경향이 있습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Delay major investments** until the outlook is clearer.
segments.tr: 1. **전망이 더 명확해질 때까지 주요 투자를 연기합니다.**

segments.src: 2. **Build up inventories** ahead of possible tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. **가능한 관세에 대비하여 재고를 구축합니다.**

segments.src: 3. **Diversify suppliers** to reduce reliance on any single border crossing.
segments.tr: 3. **단일 국경 통과에 대한 의존도를 줄이기 위해 공급업체를 다각화합니다.**

segments.src: 4. **Add price adjustment clauses** to contracts.
segments.tr: 4. **계약에 가격 조정 조항을 추가합니다.**

segments.src: These steps can themselves affect costs, even before any formal change takes place.
segments.tr: 이러한 조치 자체는 공식적인 변경이 일어나기 전에도 비용에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What Consumers and Workers Can Watch
segments.tr: ## 소비자와 노동자가 주시할 수 있는 것

segments.src: You do not need to follow every negotiating session to understand the likely effects.
segments.tr: 예상되는 영향을 이해하기 위해 모든 협상 세션을 따를 필요는 없습니다.

segments.src: A few practical signals can help:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 실용적인 신호가 도움이 될 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Official announcements** from the U.S. Trade Representative, Canada's trade ministry and Mexico's Ministry of Economy.
segments.tr: - **공식 발표,** 미국 무역대표부, 캐나다 무역부, 멕시코 경제부에서.

segments.src: - **Automaker and supplier earnings calls,** where executives often discuss expected costs and production plans.
segments.tr: - **자동차 제조업체 및 공급업체 실적 발표,** 임원들이 예상 비용과 생산 계획을 자주 논의하는 곳.

segments.src: - **Monthly inflation data,** particularly categories such as new vehicles, food and household goods.
segments.tr: - **월간 인플레이션 데이터,** 특히 신차, 식품, 가정용품 등의 범주.

segments.src: - **Industry groups** for farmers, manufacturers and retailers, which publish their own assessments.
segments.tr: - **산업 단체,** 농부, 제조업체, 소매업체를 위한 자체 평가를 게시합니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The USMCA review is about more than diplomacy.
segments.tr: USMCA 검토는 외교 그 이상에 관한 것입니다.

segments.src: It is a decision about how North American supply chains are governed, and that touches car prices, grocery bills and the jobs tied to cross-border trade.
segments.tr: 이는 북미 공급망이 어떻게 관리되는가에 대한 결정이며, 이는 자동차 가격, 식료품 고지서, 국경 간 무역에 묶인 일자리에 영향을 미칩니다.

zh.title: 北美贸易协定进入倒计时：USMCA审查对汽车、农业和价格意味着什么

segments.src: The United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement, usually shortened to USMCA, is the rulebook behind most of the goods that cross North American borders.
segments.tr: 美墨加协定（通常简称为USMCA）是管理大部分跨越北美边境商品的规则手册。

segments.src: It covers everything from pickup trucks and auto parts to dairy, corn, produce and machinery.
segments.tr: 它涵盖了从皮卡和汽车零部件到乳制品、玉米、农产品和机械的一切。

segments.src: Because the agreement includes a scheduled review, businesses, farmers and shoppers have all been paying close attention to how the three governments handle it.
segments.tr: 由于该协议包含预定的审查机制，企业、农民和购物者都一直在密切关注三国政府如何处理此事。

segments.src: This explainer covers what the review is, what each country wants, and how the outcome could reach car lots, grocery aisles and factory floors.
segments.tr: 本篇科普文章介绍了什么是审查、每个国家的需求是什么，以及结果将如何影响汽车停车场、杂货店过道和工厂车间。

segments.src: Negotiations change quickly, so check current reporting from reliable news outlets for the latest status.
segments.tr: 谈判变化迅速，请查看可靠新闻媒体的最新报道以了解最新进展。

segments.src: ## What Is the USMCA Review?
segments.tr: ## 什么是 USMCA 审查？

segments.src: The USMCA took effect on July 1, 2020, replacing the 1994 North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA).
segments.tr: USMCA 于 2020 年 7 月 1 日生效，取代了 1994 年的北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA）。

segments.src: The text includes a "joint review" at the six-year mark, in 2026.
segments.tr: 该文本规定在第六年（即 2026 年）进行“联合审查”。

segments.src: At that point each country is asked to confirm in writing whether it wants to extend the agreement's term.
segments.tr: 届时，每个国家将被要求以书面形式确认是否希望延长协议的期限。

segments.src: The mechanics matter more than the headlines suggest:
segments.tr: 其机制比头条新闻显示的更为重要：

segments.src: - **If all three countries confirm,** the agreement's term is extended for another 16 years.
segments.tr: - **如果三个国家全部确认，** 协议期限将再延长 16 年。

segments.src: - **If any country does not confirm,** the three move to annual joint reviews. The agreement does not end automatically, but it would keep a 2036 expiration date unless the parties later agree to extend it.
segments.tr: - **如果有任何国家不予确认，** 三国将转为每年进行联合审查。协议不会自动终止，但除非各方随后同意延长，否则它将保留 2036 年的到期日。

segments.src: - **Withdrawal is a separate step.** Any country can leave with six months' written notice, but that is a different process from the review.
segments.tr: - **退出是一个单独的步骤。** 任何国家都可以提前六个月发出书面通知退出，但这与审查是不同的过程。

segments.src: In short, the review is a checkpoint and a bargaining moment, not a cliff.
segments.tr: 简而言之，审查是一个检查点和一个讨价还价的时刻，而不是悬崖。

segments.src: Still, uncertainty alone can change how companies plan.
segments.tr: 尽管如此，仅凭不确定性就足以改变公司的计划方式。

segments.src: ## Why So Much Is at Stake
segments.tr: ## 为什么利害关系如此重大

segments.src: North America is one of the most integrated trading regions in the world.
segments.tr: 北美是世界上整合度最高的贸易区之一。

segments.src: The United States, Canada and Mexico trade well over a trillion dollars in goods with one another each year, and Canada and Mexico rank among the largest export markets for American producers.
segments.tr: 美国、加拿大和墨西哥每年彼此之间的商品贸易额远超一万亿美元，而加拿大和墨西哥是美国生产商最大的出口市场之一。

segments.src: Many products cross borders several times during manufacturing before they reach a customer.
segments.tr: 许多产品在到达客户手中之前，在制造过程中会多次跨越边境。

segments.src: That integration is why even small rule changes can ripple outward.
segments.tr: 这种整合正是为什么即使是微小的规则变更也会产生连锁反应。

segments.src: A tariff or a new paperwork requirement at one border can add cost to a product assembled across all three countries.
segments.tr: 一个边境上的关税或新的文书工作要求会增加在所有三个国家组装的产品的成本。

segments.src: ## Autos: The Biggest Piece of the Puzzle
segments.tr: ## 汽车：最核心的部分

segments.src: The auto sector is the most closely watched part of the review.
segments.tr: 汽车行业是审查中最受关注的部分。

segments.src: Vehicles and parts are made in a tightly linked supply chain, with engines, transmissions, wiring, seats and electronics moving back and forth across borders.
segments.tr: 汽车及其零部件在一个紧密相连的供应链中制造，发动机、变速箱、线束、座椅和电子产品在边境两侧来回流动。

segments.src: Key issues include:
segments.tr: 关键问题包括：

segments.src: - **Rules of origin.** Under current rules, a vehicle generally must have 75% of its content from North America to qualify for duty-free treatment. A share of the work must also be done by workers earning at least $16 an hour. Governments may seek to raise these thresholds or add requirements for specific components such as steel, aluminum and batteries.
segments.tr: - **原产地规则。** 根据现行规则，汽车通常必须有 75% 的零部件来自北美才有资格享受免税待遇。一部分工作还必须由时薪至少 16 美元的工人完成。各国可能会寻求提高这些门槛，或为钢铁、铝和电池等特定部件增加要求。

segments.src: - **Non-North American content.** Washington has voiced concern about parts and materials from outside the region, especially from China, entering the supply chain through Mexico or Canada.
segments.tr: - **非北美成分。** 华盛顿对来自该地区以外、特别是来自中国的零部件和材料通过墨西哥或加拿大进入供应链表示担忧。

segments.src: - **Tariffs outside the agreement.** Separate U.S. tariffs on autos, auto parts, steel and aluminum have complicated the picture. Automakers want clarity on how those measures interact with USMCA benefits.
segments.tr: - **协议之外的关税。** 美国对汽车、汽车零部件、钢铁和铝征收的单独关税使情况变得复杂。汽车制造商希望明确这些措施如何与 USMCA 的利益相互作用。

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Automakers can absorb some added costs, pass them to buyers, or reshuffle production.
segments.tr: **对价格可能意味着什么：** 汽车制造商可以吸收一些附加成本，将其转嫁给买家，或者重新调整生产。

segments.src: Any of those choices can affect sticker prices, trim availability and used-car values.
segments.tr: 任何这些选择都会影响标价、车型可用性和二手车价值。

segments.src: Analysts often note that costs tied to tariffs or stricter origin rules tend to show up gradually rather than all at once.
segments.tr: 分析师经常指出，与关税或更严格的原产地规则相关的成本往往是逐渐显现的，而不是一次性全部出现。

segments.src: ## Farms and Groceries
segments.tr: ## 农业与食品杂货

segments.src: Agriculture is another major area.
segments.tr: 农业是另一个主要领域。

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: 美国

segments.src: farmers sell large volumes of corn, soybeans, pork, beef, poultry and dairy to Mexico and Canada, while Americans buy fresh fruit, vegetables, avocados, tomatoes, beer and beef from them in return.
segments.tr: 农民向墨西哥和加拿大销售大量玉米、大豆、猪肉、牛肉、家禽和乳制品，而美国人则从他们那里购买新鲜水果、蔬菜、牛油果、西红柿、啤酒和牛肉作为回报。

segments.src: Points of friction include:
segments.tr: 摩擦点包括：

segments.src: - **Dairy.** U.S. producers have long argued that Canada's supply-management system limits their access to its market. Canada has defended that system as important to its own farmers.
segments.tr: - **乳制品。** 美国生产商长期以来一直认为加拿大的供应管理系统限制了他们进入其市场。加拿大则为该系统进行了辩护，认为这对本国农民很重要。

segments.src: - **Biotech corn.** Mexico's policies on genetically engineered corn have been a flashpoint, and a dispute panel previously ruled on part of that issue.
segments.tr: - **转基因玉米。** 墨西哥关于转基因玉米的政策一直是争论的焦点，争端解决小组先前曾对该问题的一部分做出裁决。

segments.src: - **Seasonal produce.** Growers in some U.S. states say imports compete with them during certain months, while shoppers rely on those imports for year-round supply.
segments.tr: - **季节性农产品。** 美国一些州的种植者表示，进口商品在某些月份与他们竞争，而购物者则依靠这些进口商品来保证全年的供应。

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Because many fruits and vegetables are imported during the winter, higher tariffs or trade barriers could raise grocery costs or reduce choice in some categories.
segments.tr: **对价格可能意味着什么：** 由于许多水果和蔬菜是在冬季进口的，更高的关税或贸易壁垒可能会增加杂货成本或减少某些类别的选择。

segments.src: On the export side, farmers worry that retaliation by trading partners could lower demand for U.S.
segments.tr: 在出口方面，农民担心贸易伙伴的报复可能会降低对美国

segments.src: crops and livestock.
segments.tr: 农作物和牲畜的需求。

segments.src: ## Jobs and Factories
segments.tr: ## 就业与工厂

segments.src: Manufacturing employment is a central argument on every side.
segments.tr: 制造业就业是各方争论的核心。

segments.src: Supporters of tighter rules say stronger requirements can bring production and jobs to the United States and raise wages.
segments.tr: 更严格规则的支持者表示，更强的要求可以为美国带来生产和就业机会并提高工资。

segments.src: Others caution that making cross-border supply chains more costly could reduce competitiveness against producers in Asia and Europe and put existing jobs at risk.
segments.tr: 另一些人则警告说，提高跨边境供应链的成本可能会降低对亚洲和欧洲生产商的竞争力，并使现有工作岗位面临风险。

segments.src: Mexico has an interest in keeping its position as a major manufacturing hub and in attracting investment.
segments.tr: 墨西哥有兴趣保持其作为主要制造枢纽的地位并吸引投资。

segments.src: Canada, which sends the large majority of its exports south, depends heavily on predictable access to the U.S.
segments.tr: 加拿大将其绝大部分出口产品送往南方，严重依赖对美国

segments.src: market.
segments.tr: 市场的可预测准入。

segments.src: For many communities, a single plant can be a main employer, so decisions about where to invest are watched closely.
segments.tr: 对于许多社区来说，单一工厂可能是主要的雇主，因此关于在哪里投资的决定受到密切关注。

segments.src: ## Other Topics on the Table
segments.tr: ## 桌上的其他话题

segments.src: The review is not limited to cars and crops.
segments.tr: 审查不仅限于汽车和农作物。

segments.src: Other issues that have come up include:
segments.tr: 其他出现的问题包括：

segments.src: - **Energy policy,** including the role of state-owned energy companies in Mexico.
segments.tr: - **能源政策，** 包括墨西哥国有能源公司的角色。

segments.src: - **Digital trade and online services,** including taxes and data rules.
segments.tr: - **数字贸易和在线服务，** 包括税收和数据规则。

segments.src: - **Labor standards,** such as enforcement of workers' rights in Mexican facilities.
segments.tr: - **劳工标准，** 例如在墨西哥设施中执行工人权利。

segments.src: - **Dispute settlement,** and whether the process for resolving trade disagreements is fast and effective enough.
segments.tr: - **争端解决，** 以及解决贸易分歧的过程是否足够迅速和有效。

segments.src: - **Economic security,** including how to handle investment and imports from non-member countries.
segments.tr: - **经济安全，** 包括如何处理来自非成员国的投资和进口。

segments.src: ## Why Businesses Are Bracing for Uncertainty
segments.tr: ## 为什么企业正在为不确定性做准备

segments.src: Companies make decisions years in advance.
segments.tr: 企业提前数年做出决策。

segments.src: Building or expanding a plant, signing supplier contracts and setting vehicle prices all depend on a stable set of rules.
segments.tr: 建设或扩建工厂、签署供应商合同和设定汽车价格都取决于一套稳定的规则。

segments.src: When the rules might change, firms tend to respond in familiar ways:
segments.tr: 当规则可能发生变化时，企业往往会以熟悉的方式作出反应：

segments.src: 1. **Delay major investments** until the outlook is clearer.
segments.tr: 1. **推迟重大投资，** 直到前景更加明朗。

segments.src: 2. **Build up inventories** ahead of possible tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. **建立库存，** 以应对可能的关税。

segments.src: 3. **Diversify suppliers** to reduce reliance on any single border crossing.
segments.tr: 3. **多元化供应商，** 以减少对任何单一过境点的依赖。

segments.src: 4. **Add price adjustment clauses** to contracts.
segments.tr: 4. **在合同中加入价格调整条款。**

segments.src: These steps can themselves affect costs, even before any formal change takes place.
segments.tr: 甚至在任何正式变化发生之前，这些步骤本身就会影响成本。

segments.src: ## What Consumers and Workers Can Watch
segments.tr: ## 消费者和工人可以关注什么

segments.src: You do not need to follow every negotiating session to understand the likely effects.
segments.tr: 您无需关注每一次谈判会议就能了解可能产生的影响。

segments.src: A few practical signals can help:
segments.tr: 一些实际的信号可以提供帮助：

segments.src: - **Official announcements** from the U.S. Trade Representative, Canada's trade ministry and Mexico's Ministry of Economy.
segments.tr: - 来自美国贸易代表、加拿大贸易部和墨西哥经济部的 **官方公告**。

segments.src: - **Automaker and supplier earnings calls,** where executives often discuss expected costs and production plans.
segments.tr: - **汽车制造商和供应商的财报电话会议，** 高管们经常在会上讨论预期成本和生产计划。

segments.src: - **Monthly inflation data,** particularly categories such as new vehicles, food and household goods.
segments.tr: - **月度通货膨胀数据，** 特别是新车、食品和家居用品等类别。

segments.src: - **Industry groups** for farmers, manufacturers and retailers, which publish their own assessments.
segments.tr: - 农民、制造商和零售商的 **行业组织**，它们会发布自己的评估报告。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The USMCA review is about more than diplomacy.
segments.tr: USMCA 审查不仅仅关乎外交。

segments.src: It is a decision about how North American supply chains are governed, and that touches car prices, grocery bills and the jobs tied to cross-border trade.
segments.tr: 这是一个关于如何管理北美供应链的决定，它触及了汽车价格、杂货账单以及与跨境贸易息息相关的工作岗位。

segments.src: The most likely outcomes range from a straightforward extension to a longer period of annual reviews and negotiated changes.
segments.tr: 最可能的结果从简单的延期到更长时间的年度审查和协商修改不等。

segments.src: In every scenario, the details of the rules, not just the headlines, will determine who gains and who bears the costs.
segments.tr: 在任何情况下，规则的细节（不仅仅是头条新闻）将决定谁获益以及谁承担成本。

segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考，不构成财务、投资或法律建议。

segments.tr: 贸易政策一直在演变，数字和立场可能自发布以来已经发生变化。*

segments.src: The mechanics matter more than the headlines suggest:
segments.tr: यांत्रिकी सुर्खियों के सुझाव से अधिक मायने रखती है:

segments.src: - **If all three countries confirm,** the agreement's term is extended for another 16 years.
segments.tr: - **यदि तीनों देश पुष्टि करते हैं,** तो समझौते की अवधि को अगले 16 वर्षों के लिए बढ़ा दिया जाता है।

segments.src: - **If any country does not confirm,** the three move to annual joint reviews. The agreement does not end automatically, but it would keep a 2036 expiration date unless the parties later agree to extend it.
segments.tr: - **यदि कोई देश पुष्टि नहीं करता है,** तो तीनों वार्षिक संयुक्त समीक्षाओं की ओर बढ़ते हैं। समझौता स्वचालित रूप से समाप्त नहीं होता है, लेकिन जब तक पार्टियां बाद में इसे बढ़ाने के लिए सहमत नहीं होती हैं, तब तक इसकी समाप्ति तिथि 2036 बनी रहेगी।

segments.src: - **Withdrawal is a separate step.** Any country can leave with six months' written notice, but that is a different process from the review.
segments.tr: - **निकासी एक अलग कदम है।** कोई भी देश छह महीने के लिखित नोटिस के साथ छोड़ सकता है, लेकिन यह समीक्षा से एक अलग प्रक्रिया है।

segments.src: In short, the review is a checkpoint and a bargaining moment, not a cliff.
segments.tr: संक्षेप में, समीक्षा एक चेकपॉइंट और सौदेबाजी का क्षण है, कोई चट्टान नहीं।

segments.src: Still, uncertainty alone can change how companies plan.
segments.tr: फिर भी, केवल अनिश्चितता ही कंपनियों की योजना बनाने के तरीके को बदल सकती है।

segments.src: ## Why So Much Is at Stake
segments.tr: ## इतना कुछ दांव पर क्यों है

segments.src: North America is one of the most integrated trading regions in the world.
segments.tr: उत्तरी अमेरिका दुनिया के सबसे एकीकृत व्यापारिक क्षेत्रों में से एक है।

segments.src: The United States, Canada and Mexico trade well over a trillion dollars in goods with one another each year, and Canada and Mexico rank among the largest export markets for American producers.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका, कनाडा और मेक्सिको हर साल एक-दूसरे के साथ एक ट्रिलियन डॉलर से अधिक का व्यापार करते हैं, और कनाडा और मेक्सिको अमेरिकी उत्पादकों के लिए सबसे बड़े निर्यात बाजारों में से हैं।

segments.src: Many products cross borders several times during manufacturing before they reach a customer.
segments.tr: कई उत्पाद ग्राहक तक पहुंचने से पहले निर्माण के दौरान कई बार सीमाओं को पार करते हैं।

segments.src: That integration is why even small rule changes can ripple outward.
segments.tr: वह एकीकरण ही कारण है कि छोटे नियम परिवर्तन भी बाहर की ओर फैल सकते हैं।

segments.src: A tariff or a new paperwork requirement at one border can add cost to a product assembled across all three countries.
segments.tr: एक सीमा पर टैरिफ या नई कागजी कार्रवाई की आवश्यकता तीनों देशों में इकट्ठे किए गए उत्पाद की लागत में वृद्धि कर सकती है।

segments.src: ## Autos: The Biggest Piece of the Puzzle
segments.tr: ## ऑटो: पहेली का सबसे बड़ा टुकड़ा

segments.src: The auto sector is the most closely watched part of the review.
segments.tr: ऑटो क्षेत्र समीक्षा का सबसे बारीकी से देखा जाने वाला हिस्सा है।

segments.src: Vehicles and parts are made in a tightly linked supply chain, with engines, transmissions, wiring, seats and electronics moving back and forth across borders.
segments.tr: वाहन और पुर्जे एक कसकर जुड़ी हुई आपूर्ति श्रृंखला में बनाए जाते हैं, जिसमें इंजन, ट्रांसमिशन, वायरिंग, सीटें और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स सीमाओं के पार आगे-पीछे होते हैं।

segments.src: Key issues include:
segments.tr: प्रमुख मुद्दों में शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - **Rules of origin.** Under current rules, a vehicle generally must have 75% of its content from North America to qualify for duty-free treatment. A share of the work must also be done by workers earning at least $16 an hour. Governments may seek to raise these thresholds or add requirements for specific components such as steel, aluminum and batteries.
segments.tr: - **उत्पत्ति के नियम।** वर्तमान नियमों के तहत, शुल्क-मुक्त उपचार के लिए अर्हता प्राप्त करने के लिए एक वाहन में आम तौर पर उत्तरी अमेरिका से 75% सामग्री होनी चाहिए। काम का एक हिस्सा उन श्रमिकों द्वारा भी किया जाना चाहिए जो प्रति घंटे कम से कम $16 कमाते हैं। सरकारें इन सीमाओं को बढ़ाने या स्टील, एल्यूमीनियम और बैटरी जैसे विशिष्ट घटकों के लिए आवश्यकताएं जोड़ने की मांग कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: - **Non-North American content.** Washington has voiced concern about parts and materials from outside the region, especially from China, entering the supply chain through Mexico or Canada.
segments.tr: - **गैर-उत्तरी अमेरिकी सामग्री।** वाशिंगटन ने मेक्सिको या कनाडा के माध्यम से आपूर्ति श्रृंखला में प्रवेश करने वाले क्षेत्र के बाहर से, विशेष रूप से चीन से, पुर्जों और सामग्रियों के बारे में चिंता व्यक्त की है।

segments.src: - **Tariffs outside the agreement.** Separate U.S. tariffs on autos, auto parts, steel and aluminum have complicated the picture. Automakers want clarity on how those measures interact with USMCA benefits.
segments.tr: - **समझौते के बाहर टैरिफ।** ऑटो, ऑटो पार्ट्स, स्टील और एल्यूमीनियम पर अलग-अलग अमेरिकी टैरिफ ने तस्वीर को जटिल बना दिया है। वाहन निर्माता स्पष्टता चाहते हैं कि वे उपाय USMCA लाभों के साथ कैसे बातचीत करते हैं।

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Automakers can absorb some added costs, pass them to buyers, or reshuffle production.
segments.tr: **इसका कीमतों के लिए क्या मतलब हो सकता है:** वाहन निर्माता कुछ अतिरिक्त लागतों को अवशोषित कर सकते हैं, उन्हें खरीदारों पर डाल सकते हैं, या उत्पादन को फिर से व्यवस्थित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Any of those choices can affect sticker prices, trim availability and used-car values.
segments.tr: उन विकल्पों में से कोई भी स्टिकर की कीमतों, ट्रिम उपलब्धता और पुरानी कार के मूल्यों को प्रभावित कर सकता है।

segments.src: Analysts often note that costs tied to tariffs or stricter origin rules tend to show up gradually rather than all at once.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक अक्सर नोट करते हैं कि टैरिफ या सख्त उत्पत्ति नियमों से जुड़ी लागतें एक बार में होने के बजाय धीरे-धीरे दिखाई देती हैं।

segments.src: ## Farms and Groceries
segments.tr: ## खेत और किराने का सामान

segments.src: Agriculture is another major area.
segments.tr: कृषि एक और प्रमुख क्षेत्र है।

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: अमेरिकी

segments.src: farmers sell large volumes of corn, soybeans, pork, beef, poultry and dairy to Mexico and Canada, while Americans buy fresh fruit, vegetables, avocados, tomatoes, beer and beef from them in return.
segments.tr: किसान मेक्सिको और कनाडा को मक्का, सोयाबीन, सूअर का मांस, बीफ, पोल्ट्री और डेयरी की बड़ी मात्रा बेचते हैं, जबकि अमेरिकी बदले में उनसे ताजे फल, सब्जियां, एवोकैडो, टमाटर, बीयर और बीफ खरीदते हैं।

segments.src: Points of friction include:
segments.tr: घर्षण के बिंदुओं में शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - **Dairy.** U.S. producers have long argued that Canada's supply-management system limits their access to its market. Canada has defended that system as important to its own farmers.
segments.tr: - **डेयरी।** अमेरिकी उत्पादकों ने लंबे समय से तर्क दिया है कि कनाडा की आपूर्ति-प्रबंधन प्रणाली उनके बाजार तक पहुंच को सीमित करती है। कनाडा ने उस प्रणाली का बचाव अपने स्वयं के किसानों के लिए महत्वपूर्ण के रूप में किया है।

segments.src: - **Biotech corn.** Mexico's policies on genetically engineered corn have been a flashpoint, and a dispute panel previously ruled on part of that issue.
segments.tr: - **बायोटेक मक्का।** आनुवंशिक रूप से इंजीनियर मक्का पर मेक्सिको की नीतियां एक फ्लैशपॉइंट रही हैं, और एक विवाद पैनल ने पहले उस मुद्दे के एक हिस्से पर फैसला सुनाया था।

segments.src: - **Seasonal produce.** Growers in some U.S. states say imports compete with them during certain months, while shoppers rely on those imports for year-round supply.
segments.tr: - **मौसमी उपज।** कुछ अमेरिकी राज्यों में उत्पादकों का कहना है कि आयात कुछ महीनों के दौरान उनके साथ प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं, जबकि खरीदार साल भर की आपूर्ति के लिए उन आयातों पर निर्भर रहते हैं।

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Because many fruits and vegetables are imported during the winter, higher tariffs or trade barriers could raise grocery costs or reduce choice in some categories.
segments.tr: **इसका कीमतों के लिए क्या मतलब हो सकता है:** चूंकि सर्दियों के दौरान कई फल और सब्जियां आयात की जाती हैं, इसलिए उच्च टैरिफ या व्यापार बाधाएं किराने की लागत बढ़ा सकती हैं या कुछ श्रेणियों में विकल्प कम कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: On the export side, farmers worry that retaliation by trading partners could lower demand for U.S.
segments.tr: निर्यात पक्ष पर, किसानों को चिंता है कि व्यापारिक भागीदारों द्वारा प्रतिशोध अमेरिकी

segments.src: crops and livestock.
segments.tr: फसलों और पशुधन की मांग को कम कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## Jobs and Factories
segments.tr: ## नौकरियां और कारखाने

segments.src: Manufacturing employment is a central argument on every side.
segments.tr: विनिर्माण रोजगार हर तरफ एक केंद्रीय तर्क है।

segments.src: Supporters of tighter rules say stronger requirements can bring production and jobs to the United States and raise wages.
segments.tr: सख्त नियमों के समर्थक कहते हैं कि मजबूत आवश्यकताएं उत्पादन और नौकरियों को संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में ला सकती हैं और मजदूरी बढ़ा सकती हैं।

segments.src: Others caution that making cross-border supply chains more costly could reduce competitiveness against producers in Asia and Europe and put existing jobs at risk.
segments.tr: अन्य लोग चेतावनी देते हैं कि सीमा पार आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं को अधिक महंगा बनाने से एशिया और यूरोप के उत्पादकों के खिलाफ प्रतिस्पर्धात्मकता कम हो सकती है और मौजूदा नौकरियां जोखिम में पड़ सकती हैं।

segments.src: Mexico has an interest in keeping its position as a major manufacturing hub and in attracting investment.
segments.tr: मेक्सिको की एक प्रमुख विनिर्माण केंद्र के रूप में अपनी स्थिति बनाए रखने और निवेश को आकर्षित करने में रुचि है।

segments.src: Canada, which sends the large majority of its exports south, depends heavily on predictable access to the U.S.
segments.tr: कनाडा, जो अपने निर्यात का बड़ा हिस्सा दक्षिण में भेजता है, अमेरिकी

segments.src: market.
segments.tr: बाजार तक अनुमानित पहुंच पर भारी निर्भर करता है।

segments.src: For many communities, a single plant can be a main employer, so decisions about where to invest are watched closely.
segments.tr: कई समुदायों के लिए, एक एकल संयंत्र एक मुख्य नियोक्ता हो सकता है, इसलिए निवेश कहां करना है, इस पर निर्णय बारीकी से देखे जाते हैं।

segments.src: ## Other Topics on the Table
segments.tr: ## मेज पर अन्य विषय

segments.src: The review is not limited to cars and crops.
segments.tr: समीक्षा केवल कारों और फसलों तक सीमित नहीं है।

segments.src: Other issues that have come up include:
segments.tr: अन्य मुद्दे जो सामने आए हैं उनमें शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - **Energy policy,** including the role of state-owned energy companies in Mexico.
segments.tr: - **ऊर्जा नीति,** जिसमें मेक्सिको में राज्य के स्वामित्व वाली ऊर्जा कंपनियों की भूमिका शामिल है।

segments.src: - **Digital trade and online services,** including taxes and data rules.
segments.tr: - **डिजिटल व्यापार और ऑनलाइन सेवाएं,** जिसमें कर और डेटा नियम शामिल हैं।

segments.src: - **Labor standards,** such as enforcement of workers' rights in Mexican facilities.
segments.tr: - **श्रम मानक,** जैसे मैक्सिकन सुविधाओं में श्रमिकों के अधिकारों का प्रवर्तन।

segments.src: - **Dispute settlement,** and whether the process for resolving trade disagreements is fast and effective enough.
segments.tr: - **विवाद निपटान,** और क्या व्यापार असहमति को हल करने की प्रक्रिया पर्याप्त तेज और प्रभावी है।

segments.src: - **Economic security,** including how to handle investment and imports from non-member countries.
segments.tr: - **आर्थिक सुरक्षा,** जिसमें गैर-सदस्य देशों से निवेश और आयात को कैसे संभालना है, शामिल है।

segments.src: ## Why Businesses Are Bracing for Uncertainty
segments.tr: ## व्यवसाय अनिश्चितता के लिए क्यों तैयार हो रहे हैं

segments.src: Companies make decisions years in advance.
segments.tr: कंपनियां वर्षों पहले निर्णय लेती हैं।

segments.src: Building or expanding a plant, signing supplier contracts and setting vehicle prices all depend on a stable set of rules.
segments.tr: संयंत्र का निर्माण या विस्तार करना, आपूर्तिकर्ता अनुबंधों पर हस्ताक्षर करना और वाहन की कीमतें निर्धारित करना सभी नियमों के एक स्थिर सेट पर निर्भर करते हैं।

segments.src: When the rules might change, firms tend to respond in familiar ways:
segments.tr: जब नियम बदल सकते हैं, तो फर्में परिचित तरीकों से प्रतिक्रिया करती हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Delay major investments** until the outlook is clearer.
segments.tr: 1. **प्रमुख निवेशों में देरी करें** जब तक कि दृष्टिकोण स्पष्ट न हो जाए।

segments.src: 2. **Build up inventories** ahead of possible tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. **इन्वेंट्री बनाएं** संभावित टैरिफ से पहले।

segments.src: 3. **Diversify suppliers** to reduce reliance on any single border crossing.
segments.tr: 3. **आपूर्तिकर्ताओं में विविधता लाएं** किसी भी एकल सीमा पार करने पर निर्भरता कम करने के लिए।

segments.src: 4. **Add price adjustment clauses** to contracts.
segments.tr: 4. **अनुबंधों में मूल्य समायोजन खंड जोड़ें।**

segments.src: These steps can themselves affect costs, even before any formal change takes place.
segments.tr: ये कदम स्वयं लागत को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं, इससे पहले कि कोई औपचारिक परिवर्तन हो।

segments.src: ## What Consumers and Workers Can Watch
segments.tr: ## उपभोक्ता और श्रमिक क्या देख सकते हैं

segments.src: You do not need to follow every negotiating session to understand the likely effects.
segments.tr: संभावित प्रभावों को समझने के लिए आपको हर बातचीत सत्र का पालन करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

segments.src: A few practical signals can help:
segments.tr: कुछ व्यावहारिक संकेत मदद कर सकते हैं:

segments.src: - **Official announcements** from the U.S. Trade Representative, Canada's trade ministry and Mexico's Ministry of Economy.
segments.tr: - **आधिकारिक घोषणाएं** अमेरिकी व्यापार प्रतिनिधि, कनाडा के व्यापार मंत्रालय और मेक्सिको के अर्थव्यवस्था मंत्रालय से।

segments.src: - **Automaker and supplier earnings calls,** where executives often discuss expected costs and production plans.
segments.tr: - **वाहन निर्माता और आपूर्तिकर्ता कमाई कॉल,** जहां अधिकारी अक्सर अपेक्षित लागत और उत्पादन योजनाओं पर चर्चा करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Monthly inflation data,** particularly categories such as new vehicles, food and household goods.

es.title: El pacto comercial de Norteamérica en marcha: qué significa la revisión del T-MEC para autos, agricultura y precios

segments.src: The United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement, usually shortened to USMCA, is the rulebook behind most of the goods that cross North American borders.
segments.tr: El Tratado entre México, Estados Unidos y Canadá, habitualmente abreviado como T-MEC, es el libro de reglas detrás de la mayoría de los bienes que cruzan las fronteras norteamericanas.

segments.src: It covers everything from pickup trucks and auto parts to dairy, corn, produce and machinery.
segments.tr: Abarca desde camionetas y autopartes hasta lácteos, maíz, productos agrícolas y maquinaria.

segments.src: Because the agreement includes a scheduled review, businesses, farmers and shoppers have all been paying close attention to how the three governments handle it.
segments.tr: Debido a que el acuerdo incluye una revisión programada, las empresas, los agricultores y los compradores han estado prestando mucha atención a cómo los tres gobiernos lo manejan.

segments.src: This explainer covers what the review is, what each country wants, and how the outcome could reach car lots, grocery aisles and factory floors.
segments.tr: Este artículo explicativo cubre en qué consiste la revisión, qué quiere cada país y cómo el resultado podría llegar a los lotes de automóviles, los pasillos de los supermercados y las plantas de producción.

segments.src: Negotiations change quickly, so check current reporting from reliable news outlets for the latest status.
segments.tr: Las negociaciones cambian rápidamente, así que consulte los reportes actuales de medios de noticias confiables para conocer el estado más reciente.

segments.src: ## What Is the USMCA Review?
segments.tr: ## ¿Qué es la revisión del T-MEC?

segments.src: The USMCA took effect on July 1, 2020, replacing the 1994 North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA).
segments.tr: El T-MEC entró en vigor el 1 de julio de 2020, reemplazando al Tratado de Libre Comercio de América del Norte (TLCAN) de 1994.

segments.src: The text includes a "joint review" at the six-year mark, in 2026.
segments.tr: El texto incluye una "revisión conjunta" al cumplirse seis años, en 2026.

segments.src: At that point each country is asked to confirm in writing whether it wants to extend the agreement's term.
segments.tr: En ese momento, a cada país se le pide que confirme por escrito si desea extender la vigencia del acuerdo.

segments.src: The mechanics matter more than the headlines suggest:
segments.tr: Los mecanismos importan más de lo que sugieren los titulares:

segments.src: - **If all three countries confirm,** the agreement's term is extended for another 16 years.
segments.tr: - **Si los tres países confirman,** la vigencia del acuerdo se extiende por otros 16 años.

segments.src: - **If any country does not confirm,** the three move to annual joint reviews. The agreement does not end automatically, but it would keep a 2036 expiration date unless the parties later agree to extend it.
segments.tr: - **Si algún país no confirma,** los tres pasan a revisiones conjuntas anuales. El acuerdo no termina automáticamente, pero mantendría una fecha de expiración en 2036 a menos que las partes acuerden posteriormente extenderlo.

segments.src: - **Withdrawal is a separate step.** Any country can leave with six months' written notice, but that is a different process from the review.
segments.tr: - **La retirada es un paso separado.** Cualquier país puede salir con un aviso por escrito con seis meses de anticipación, pero ese es un proceso diferente al de la revisión.

segments.src: In short, the review is a checkpoint and a bargaining moment, not a cliff.
segments.tr: En resumen, la revisión es un punto de control y un momento de negociación, no un precipicio.

segments.src: Still, uncertainty alone can change how companies plan.
segments.tr: Aun así, la incertidumbre por sí sola puede cambiar la forma en que las empresas planifican.

segments.src: ## Why So Much Is at Stake
segments.tr: ## Por qué hay tanto en juego

segments.src: North America is one of the most integrated trading regions in the world.
segments.tr: Norteamérica es una de las regiones comerciales más integradas del mundo.

segments.src: The United States, Canada and Mexico trade well over a trillion dollars in goods with one another each year, and Canada and Mexico rank among the largest export markets for American producers.
segments.tr: Estados Unidos, Canadá y México comercian bastante más de un billón de dólares en bienes entre sí cada año, y Canadá y México se encuentran entre los mercados de exportación más grandes para los productores estadounidenses.

segments.src: Many products cross borders several times during manufacturing before they reach a customer.
segments.tr: Muchos productos cruzan las fronteras varias veces durante su fabricación antes de llegar a un cliente.

segments.src: That integration is why even small rule changes can ripple outward.
segments.tr: Esa integración es la razón por la cual incluso pequeños cambios en las reglas pueden tener repercusiones.

segments.src: A tariff or a new paperwork requirement at one border can add cost to a product assembled across all three countries.
segments.tr: Un arancel o un nuevo requisito de papeleo en una frontera puede agregar costos a un producto ensamblado en los tres países.

segments.src: ## Autos: The Biggest Piece of the Puzzle
segments.tr: ## Autos: la pieza más importante del rompecabezas

segments.src: The auto sector is the most closely watched part of the review.
segments.tr: El sector automotriz es la parte de la revisión que se sigue más de cerca.

segments.src: Vehicles and parts are made in a tightly linked supply chain, with engines, transmissions, wiring, seats and electronics moving back and forth across borders.
segments.tr: Los vehículos y las piezas se fabrican en una cadena de suministro estrechamente vinculada, con motores, transmisiones, cableado, asientos y componentes electrónicos que se mueven de un lado a otro de las fronteras.

segments.src: Key issues include:
segments.tr: Los temas clave incluyen:

segments.src: - **Rules of origin.** Under current rules, a vehicle generally must have 75% of its content from North America to qualify for duty-free treatment. A share of the work must also be done by workers earning at least $16 an hour. Governments may seek to raise these thresholds or add requirements for specific components such as steel, aluminum and batteries.
segments.tr: - **Reglas de origen.** Bajo las reglas actuales, un vehículo generalmente debe tener el 75% de su contenido originario de Norteamérica para calificar para un trato libre de aranceles. Una parte del trabajo también debe ser realizada por trabajadores que ganen al menos $16 por hora. Los gobiernos pueden buscar elevar estos umbrales o agregar requisitos para componentes específicos como acero, aluminio y baterías.

segments.src: - **Non-North American content.** Washington has voiced concern about parts and materials from outside the region, especially from China, entering the supply chain through Mexico or Canada.
segments.tr: - **Contenido no norteamericano.** Washington ha expresado su preocupación de que piezas y materiales de fuera de la región, especialmente de China, entren a la cadena de suministro a través de México o Canadá.

segments.src: - **Tariffs outside the agreement.** Separate U.S. tariffs on autos, auto parts, steel and aluminum have complicated the picture. Automakers want clarity on how those measures interact with USMCA benefits.
segments.tr: - **Aranceles fuera del acuerdo.** Los aranceles estadounidenses independientes sobre automóviles, autopartes, acero y aluminio han complicado el panorama. Los fabricantes de automóviles quieren claridad sobre cómo esas medidas interactúan con los beneficios del T-MEC.

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Automakers can absorb some added costs, pass them to buyers, or reshuffle production.
segments.tr: **Lo que podría significar para los precios:** Los fabricantes de automóviles pueden absorber algunos costos adicionales, trasladarlos a los compradores o reorganizar la producción.

segments.src: Any of those choices can affect sticker prices, trim availability and used-car values.
segments.tr: Cualquiera de esas opciones puede afectar los precios de etiqueta, la disponibilidad de versiones y los valores de los autos usados.

segments.src: Analysts often note that costs tied to tariffs or stricter origin rules tend to show up gradually rather than all at once.
segments.tr: Los analistas a menudo señalan que los costos vinculados a aranceles o reglas de origen más estrictas tienden a manifestarse gradualmente y no todos de golpe.

segments.src: ## Farms and Groceries
segments.tr: ## Agricultura y alimentos

segments.src: Agriculture is another major area.
segments.tr: La agricultura es otra área importante.

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: Los agricultores de EE. UU.

segments.src: farmers sell large volumes of corn, soybeans, pork, beef, poultry and dairy to Mexico and Canada, while Americans buy fresh fruit, vegetables, avocados, tomatoes, beer and beef from them in return.
segments.tr: venden grandes volúmenes de maíz, soya, carne de cerdo, carne de res, aves y lácteos a México y Canadá, mientras que los estadounidenses compran a cambio fruta fresca, verduras, aguacates, tomates, cerveza y carne de res.

segments.src: Points of friction include:
segments.tr: Los puntos de fricción incluyen:

segments.src: - **Dairy.** U.S. producers have long argued that Canada's supply-management system limits their access to its market. Canada has defended that system as important to its own farmers.
segments.tr: - **Lácteos.** Los productores estadounidenses han argumentado durante mucho tiempo que el sistema de gestión de oferta de Canadá limita su acceso a su mercado. Canadá ha defendido ese sistema por considerarlo importante para sus propios agricultores.

segments.src: - **Biotech corn.** Mexico's policies on genetically engineered corn have been a flashpoint, and a dispute panel previously ruled on part of that issue.
segments.tr: - **Maíz biotecnológico.** Las políticas de México sobre el maíz genéticamente modificado han sido un punto de conflicto, y un panel de solución de controversias ya se pronunció anteriormente sobre parte de ese tema.

segments.src: - **Seasonal produce.** Growers in some U.S. states say imports compete with them during certain months, while shoppers rely on those imports for year-round supply.
segments.tr: - **Productos agrícolas de temporada.** Los productores en algunos estados de EE. UU. dicen que las importaciones compiten con ellos durante ciertos meses, mientras que los compradores dependen de esas importaciones para el suministro durante todo el año.

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Because many fruits and vegetables are imported during the winter, higher tariffs or trade barriers could raise grocery costs or reduce choice in some categories.
segments.tr: **Lo que podría significar para los precios:** Debido a que muchas frutas y verduras se importan durante el invierno, aranceles más altos o barreras comerciales podrían elevar los costos de los alimentos o reducir las opciones en algunas categorías.

segments.src: On the export side, farmers worry that retaliation by trading partners could lower demand for U.S.
segments.tr: Por el lado de las exportaciones, los agricultores temen que las represalias de los socios comerciales puedan reducir la demanda de cultivos y ganado de EE. UU.

segments.src: crops and livestock.
## Jobs and Factories
segments.tr: ## Empleos y fábricas

segments.src: Manufacturing employment is a central argument on every side.
segments.tr: El empleo manufacturero es un argumento central en todos los bandos.

segments.src: Supporters of tighter rules say stronger requirements can bring production and jobs to the United States and raise wages.
segments.tr: Los partidarios de reglas más estrictas dicen que requisitos más sólidos pueden atraer producción y empleos a Estados Unidos y aumentar los salarios.

segments.src: Others caution that making cross-border supply chains more costly could reduce competitiveness against producers in Asia and Europe and put existing jobs at risk.
segments.tr: Otros advierten que encarecer las cadenas de suministro transfronterizas podría reducir la competitividad frente a los productores de Asia y Europa y poner en riesgo los empleos existentes.

segments.src: Mexico has an interest in keeping its position as a major manufacturing hub and in attracting investment.
segments.tr: México tiene interés en mantener su posición como un importante centro manufacturero y en atraer inversión.

segments.src: Canada, which sends the large majority of its exports south, depends heavily on predictable access to the U.S.
segments.tr: Canadá, que envía la gran mayoría de sus exportaciones hacia el sur, depende en gran medida del acceso predecible al mercado

segments.src: market.
segments.tr: estadounidense.

segments.src: For many communities, a single plant can be a main employer, so decisions about where to invest are watched closely.
segments.tr: Para muchas comunidades, una sola planta puede ser el empleador principal, por lo que las decisiones sobre dónde invertir se siguen de cerca.

segments.src: ## Other Topics on the Table
segments.tr: ## Otros temas sobre la mesa

segments.src: The review is not limited to cars and crops.
segments.tr: La revisión no se limita a los automóviles y las cosechas.

segments.src: Other issues that have come up include:
segments.tr: Otros temas que han surgido incluyen:

segments.src: - **Energy policy,** including the role of state-owned energy companies in Mexico.
segments.tr: - **Política energética,** incluido el papel de las empresas energéticas estatales en México.

segments.src: - **Digital trade and online services,** including taxes and data rules.
segments.tr: - **Comercio digital y servicios en línea,** incluidos los impuestos y las reglas de datos.

segments.src: - **Labor standards,** such as enforcement of workers' rights in Mexican facilities.
segments.tr: - **Estándares laborales,** como la aplicación de los derechos de los trabajadores en las instalaciones mexicanas.

segments.src: - **Dispute settlement,** and whether the process for resolving trade disagreements is fast and effective enough.
segments.tr: - **Solución de controversias,** y si el proceso para resolver desacuerdos comerciales es lo suficientemente rápido y eficaz.

segments.src: - **Economic security,** including how to handle investment and imports from non-member countries.
segments.tr: - **Seguridad económica,** incluida la forma de gestionar la inversión y las importaciones de países no miembros.

segments.src: ## Why Businesses Are Bracing for Uncertainty
segments.tr: ## Por qué las empresas se preparan para la incertidumbre

segments.src: Companies make decisions years in advance.
segments.tr: Las empresas toman decisiones con años de anticipación.

segments.src: Building or expanding a plant, signing supplier contracts and setting vehicle prices all depend on a stable set of rules.
segments.tr: Construir o ampliar una planta, firmar contratos con proveedores y fijar los precios de los vehículos dependen de un conjunto estable de reglas.

segments.src: When the rules might change, firms tend to respond in familiar ways:
segments.tr: Cuando las reglas pueden cambiar, las empresas tienden a responder de manera previsible:

segments.src: 1. **Delay major investments** until the outlook is clearer.
segments.tr: 1. **Retrasar las inversiones importantes** hasta que el panorama sea más claro.

segments.src: 2. **Build up inventories** ahead of possible tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. **Acumular inventarios** antes de posibles aranceles.

segments.src: 3. **Diversify suppliers** to reduce reliance on any single border crossing.
segments.tr: 3. **Diversificar proveedores** para reducir la dependencia de cualquier cruce fronterizo en particular.

segments.src: 4. **Add price adjustment clauses** to contracts.
segments.tr: 4. **Agregar cláusulas de ajuste de precios** a los contratos.

segments.src: These steps can themselves affect costs, even before any formal change takes place.
segments.tr: Estos pasos pueden afectar por sí mismos los costos, incluso antes de que se produzca cualquier cambio formal.

segments.src: ## What Consumers and Workers Can Watch
segments.tr: ## Qué pueden observar los consumidores y los trabajadores

segments.src: You do not need to follow every negotiating session to understand the likely effects.
segments.tr: No es necesario seguir cada sesión de negociación para comprender los efectos probables.

segments.src: A few practical signals can help:
segments.tr: Algunas señales prácticas pueden ayudar:

segments.src: - **Official announcements** from the U.S. Trade Representative, Canada's trade ministry and Mexico's Ministry of Economy.
segments.tr: - **Anuncios oficiales** de la Representación Comercial de Estados Unidos, el ministerio de comercio de Canadá y la Secretaría de Economía de México.

segments.src: - **Automaker and supplier earnings calls,** where executives often discuss expected costs and production plans.
segments.tr: - **Conferencias de resultados de fabricantes de automóviles y proveedores,** donde los ejecutivos a menudo discuten los costos esperados y los planes de producción.

segments.src: - **Monthly inflation data,** particularly categories such as new vehicles, food and household goods.
segments.tr: - **Datos mensuales de inflación,** particularmente en categorías como vehículos nuevos, alimentos y artículos para el hogar.

segments.src: - **Industry groups** for farmers, manufacturers and retailers, which publish their own assessments.
segments.tr: - **Grupos industriales** de agricultores, fabricantes y minoristas, que publican sus propias evaluaciones.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## El resultado final

segments.tr: La revisión del T-MEC trata de algo más que diplomacia.

segments.src: That integration is why even small rule changes can ripple outward.
segments.tr: Cette intégration explique pourquoi même de petits changements de règles peuvent avoir des répercussions en cascade.

segments.src: A tariff or a new paperwork requirement at one border can add cost to a product assembled across all three countries.
segments.tr: Un droit de douane ou une nouvelle exigence en matière de paperasse à une frontière peut augmenter le coût d'un produit assemblé dans les trois pays.

segments.src: ## Autos: The Biggest Piece of the Puzzle
segments.tr: ## Automobile : la pièce maîtresse du puzzle

segments.src: The auto sector is the most closely watched part of the review.
segments.tr: Le secteur automobile est la partie la plus étroitement surveillée de la révision.

segments.src: Vehicles and parts are made in a tightly linked supply chain, with engines, transmissions, wiring, seats and electronics moving back and forth across borders.
segments.tr: Les véhicules et les pièces sont fabriqués au sein d'une chaîne d'approvisionnement étroitement liée, les moteurs, les transmissions, le câblage, les sièges et l'électronique faisant de multiples va-et-vient de part et d'autre des frontières.

segments.src: Key issues include:
segments.tr: Les principaux enjeux comprennent :

segments.src: - **Rules of origin.** Under current rules, a vehicle generally must have 75% of its content from North America to qualify for duty-free treatment. A share of the work must also be done by workers earning at least $16 an hour. Governments may seek to raise these thresholds or add requirements for specific components such as steel, aluminum and batteries.
segments.tr: - **Les règles d'origine.** Selon les règles actuelles, un véhicule doit généralement provenir à 75 % d'Amérique du Nord pour bénéficier d'un traitement en franchise de droits. Une part du travail doit également être effectuée par des travailleurs gagnant au moins 16 $ de l'heure. Les gouvernements pourraient chercher à relever ces seuils ou à ajouter des exigences pour des composants spécifiques tels que l'acier, l'aluminium et les batteries.

segments.src: - **Non-North American content.** Washington has voiced concern about parts and materials from outside the region, especially from China, entering the supply chain through Mexico or Canada.
segments.tr: - **Le contenu non nord-américain.** Washington a exprimé des inquiétudes concernant l'entrée de pièces et de matériaux provenant de l'extérieur de la région, en particulier de la Chine, dans la chaîne d'approvisionnement via le Mexique ou le Canada.

segments.src: - **Tariffs outside the agreement.** Separate U.S. tariffs on autos, auto parts, steel and aluminum have complicated the picture. Automakers want clarity on how those measures interact with USMCA benefits.
segments.tr: - **Les droits de douane hors accord.** Des droits de douane américains distincts sur les automobiles, les pièces automobiles, l'acier et l'aluminium ont compléxifié la situation. Les constructeurs automobiles veulent de la clarté sur la manière dont ces mesures interagissent avec les avantages de l'ACEUM.

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Automakers can absorb some added costs, pass them to buyers, or reshuffle production.
segments.tr: **Ce que cela pourrait signifier pour les prix :** Les constructeurs automobiles peuvent absorber certains coûts supplémentaires, les répercuter sur les acheteurs ou réorganiser leur production.

segments.src: Any of those choices can affect sticker prices, trim availability and used-car values.
segments.tr: Chacun de ces choix peut affecter les prix affichés, la disponibilité des finitions et la valeur des véhicules d'occasion.

segments.src: Analysts often note that costs tied to tariffs or stricter origin rules tend to show up gradually rather than all at once.
segments.tr: Les analystes soulignent souvent que les coûts liés aux droits de douane ou aux règles d'origine plus strictes ont tendance à se manifester progressivement plutôt que tous en même temps.

segments.src: ## Farms and Groceries
segments.tr: ## Agriculture et épicerie

segments.src: Agriculture is another major area.
segments.tr: L'agriculture est un autre domaine majeur.

segments.src: farmers sell large volumes of corn, soybeans, pork, beef, poultry and dairy to Mexico and Canada, while Americans buy fresh fruit, vegetables, avocados, tomatoes, beer and beef from them in return.

segments.src: Points of friction include:
segments.tr: Les points de friction comprennent :

segments.src: - **Dairy.** U.S. producers have long argued that Canada's supply-management system limits their access to its market. Canada has defended that system as important to its own farmers.
segments.tr: - **Les produits laitiers.** Les producteurs américains soutiennent depuis longtemps que le système canadien de gestion de l'offre limite leur accès à son marché. Le Canada a défendu ce système comme étant important pour ses propres agriculteurs.

segments.src: - **Biotech corn.** Mexico's policies on genetically engineered corn have been a flashpoint, and a dispute panel previously ruled on part of that issue.
segments.tr: - **Le maïs biotechnologique.** Les politiques du Mexique concernant le maïs génétiquement modifié ont constitué un point de friction, et un groupe spécial de règlement des différends s'est déjà prononcé sur une partie de cette question.

segments.src: - **Seasonal produce.** Growers in some U.S. states say imports compete with them during certain months, while shoppers rely on those imports for year-round supply.
segments.tr: - **Les produits de saison.** Les producteurs de certains États américains affirment que les importations font concurrence à leurs produits pendant certains mois, tandis que les acheteurs comptent sur ces importations pour un approvisionnement toute l'année.

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Because many fruits and vegetables are imported during the winter, higher tariffs or trade barriers could raise grocery costs or reduce choice in some categories.
segments.tr: **Ce que cela pourrait signifier pour les prix :** Étant donné que de nombreux fruits et légumes sont importés pendant l'hiver, des droits de douane plus élevés ou des barrières commerciales pourraient faire augmenter les coûts des produits d'épicerie ou réduire le choix dans certaines catégories.

segments.src: On the export side, farmers worry that retaliation by trading partners could lower demand for U.S.
segments.tr: Du côté des exportations, les agriculteurs craignent que des mesures de rétorsion de la part des partenaires commerciaux ne réduisent la demande de cultures et de bétail américains.

## Jobs and Factories
segments.tr: ## Emplois et usines

segments.src: Manufacturing employment is a central argument on every side.
segments.tr: L'emploi dans le secteur manufacturier est un argument central de tous les côtés.

segments.src: Supporters of tighter rules say stronger requirements can bring production and jobs to the United States and raise wages.
segments.tr: Les partisans de règles plus strictes affirment que des exigences renforcées peuvent ramener la production et les emplois aux États-Unis et faire augmenter les salaires.

segments.src: Others caution that making cross-border supply chains more costly could reduce competitiveness against producers in Asia and Europe and put existing jobs at risk.
segments.tr: D'autres préviennent que rendre les chaînes d'approvisionnement transfrontalières plus coûteuses pourrait réduire la compétitivité face aux producteurs en Asie et en Europe et mettre en danger les emplois existants.

segments.src: Mexico has an interest in keeping its position as a major manufacturing hub and in attracting investment.
segments.tr: Le Mexique a intérêt à maintenir sa position de plaque tournante manufacturière majeure et à attirer les investissements.

segments.src: Canada, which sends the large majority of its exports south, depends heavily on predictable access to the U.S.
segments.tr: Le Canada, qui envoie la grande majorité de ses exportations vers le sud, dépend fortement d'un accès prévisible au marché américain.

segments.tr: marché.

segments.src: For many communities, a single plant can be a main employer, so decisions about where to invest are watched closely.
segments.tr: Pour de nombreuses communautés, une seule usine peut être le principal employeur, de sorte que les décisions concernant les lieux d'investissement sont suivies de très près.

segments.src: ## Other Topics on the Table
segments.tr: ## Autres sujets sur la table

segments.src: The review is not limited to cars and crops.
segments.tr: La révision ne se limite pas aux voitures et aux cultures.

segments.src: Other issues that have come up include:
segments.tr: D'autres questions ont été soulevées, notamment :

segments.src: - **Energy policy,** including the role of state-owned energy companies in Mexico.
segments.tr: - **La politique énergétique,** y compris le rôle des entreprises énergétiques publiques au Mexique.

segments.src: - **Digital trade and online services,** including taxes and data rules.
segments.tr: - **Le commerce numérique et les services en ligne,** y compris les taxes et les règles sur les données.

segments.src: - **Labor standards,** such as enforcement of workers' rights in Mexican facilities.
segments.tr: - **Les normes du travail,** telles que l'application des droits des travailleurs dans les installations mexicaines.

segments.src: - **Dispute settlement,** and whether the process for resolving trade disagreements is fast and effective enough.
segments.tr: - **Le règlement des différends,** et la question de savoir si le processus de résolution des désaccords commerciaux est suffisamment rapide et efficace.

segments.src: - **Economic security,** including how to handle investment and imports from non-member countries.
segments.tr: - **La sécurité économique,** y compris la manière de gérer les investissements et les importations en provenance de pays non membres.

segments.src: ## Why Businesses Are Bracing for Uncertainty
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les entreprises se préparent à l'incertitude

segments.src: Companies make decisions years in advance.
segments.tr: Les entreprises prennent des décisions des années à l'avance.

segments.src: Building or expanding a plant, signing supplier contracts and setting vehicle prices all depend on a stable set of rules.
segments.tr: Construire ou agrandir une usine, signer des contrats avec des fournisseurs et fixer le prix des véhicules dépendent tous d'un ensemble de règles stables.

segments.src: When the rules might change, firms tend to respond in familiar ways:
segments.tr: Lorsque les règles sont susceptibles de changer, les firmes ont tendance à réagir de manière familière :

segments.src: 1. **Delay major investments** until the outlook is clearer.
segments.tr: 1. **Retarder les investissements majeurs** jusqu'à ce que les perspectives soient plus claires.

segments.src: 2. **Build up inventories** ahead of possible tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. **Constituer des stocks** avant d'éventuels droits de douane.

segments.src: 3. **Diversify suppliers** to reduce reliance on any single border crossing.
segments.tr: 3. **Diversifier les fournisseurs** pour réduire la dépendance à l'égard d'un seul point de passage frontalier.

segments.src: 4. **Add price adjustment clauses** to contracts.
segments.tr: 4. **Ajouter des clauses de révision des prix** aux contrats.

segments.src: These steps can themselves affect costs, even before any formal change takes place.
segments.tr: Ces mesures peuvent elles-mêmes affecter les coûts, avant même qu'un changement officiel n'intervienne.

segments.src: ## What Consumers and Workers Can Watch
segments.tr: ## Ce que les consommateurs et les travailleurs peuvent surveiller

segments.src: You do not need to follow every negotiating session to understand the likely effects.
segments.tr: Il n'est pas nécessaire de suivre chaque session de négociation pour comprendre les effets probables.

segments.src: A few practical signals can help:
segments.tr: Quelques signaux pratiques peuvent aider :

segments.src: - **Official announcements** from the U.S. Trade Representative, Canada's trade ministry and Mexico's Ministry of Economy.
segments.tr: - **Les annonces officielles** du représentant au Commerce des États-Unis, du ministère du Commerce du Canada et du ministère de l'Économie du Mexique.

segments.src: - **Automaker and supplier earnings calls,** where executives often discuss expected costs and production plans.
segments.tr: - **Les téléconférences sur les résultats des constructeurs et fournisseurs automobiles,** où les dirigeants discutent souvent des coûts prévus et des plans de production.

segments.src: - **Monthly inflation data,** particularly categories such as new vehicles, food and household goods.
segments.tr: - **Les données mensuelles sur l'inflation,** en particulier dans des catégories telles que les véhicules neufs, l'alimentation et les biens ménagers.

segments.src: - **Industry groups** for farmers, manufacturers and retailers, which publish their own assessments.
segments.tr: - **Les groupes industriels** représentant les agriculteurs, les fabricants et les détaillants, qui publient leurs propres évaluations.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: The USMCA review is about more than diplomacy.
segments.tr: La révision de l'ACEUM va au-delà de la diplomatie.

segments.src: It is a decision about how North American supply chains are governed, and that touches car prices, grocery bills and the jobs tied to cross-border trade.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'une décision sur la manière dont les chaînes d'approvisionnement nord-américaines sont régies, ce qui touche les prix des voitures, les factures d'épicerie et les emplois liés au commerce transfrontalier.

segments.src: The most likely outcomes range from a straightforward extension to a longer period of annual reviews and negotiated changes.
segments.tr: Les résultats les plus probables vont d'une prolongation pure et simple à une période plus longue de révisions annuelles et de changements négociés.

segments.src: In every scenario, the details of the rules, not just the headlines, will determine who gains and who bears the costs.
segments.tr: Dans tous les scénarios, ce sont les détails des règles, et non seulement les grands titres, qui détermineront qui en profite et qui en supporte les coûts.

segments.src: It covers everything from pickup trucks and auto parts to dairy, corn, produce and machinery.
segments.tr: Ele abrange desde picapes e autopeças até laticínios, milho, produtos agrícolas e maquinário.

segments.src: Because the agreement includes a scheduled review, businesses, farmers and shoppers have all been paying close attention to how the three governments handle it.
segments.tr: Como o acordo inclui uma revisão programada, empresas, agricultores e consumidores têm prestado muita atenção em como os três governos vão lidar com isso.

segments.src: This explainer covers what the review is, what each country wants, and how the outcome could reach car lots, grocery aisles and factory floors.

segments.src: ## What Is the USMCA Review?
segments.tr: ## O Que É a Revisão do USMCA?

segments.src: The USMCA took effect on July 1, 2020, replacing the 1994 North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA).
segments.tr: O USMCA entrou em vigor em 1 de julho de 2020, substituindo o Tratado Norte-Americano de Livre Comércio (NAFTA) de 1994.

segments.src: The text includes a "joint review" at the six-year mark, in 2026.
segments.tr: O texto inclui uma "revisão conjunta" no marco de seis anos, em 2026.

segments.src: At that point each country is asked to confirm in writing whether it wants to extend the agreement's term.
segments.tr: Nesse ponto, cada país é solicitado a confirmar por escrito se deseja estender o prazo do acordo.

segments.src: The mechanics matter more than the headlines suggest:
segments.tr: A mecânica importa mais do que as manchetes sugerem:

segments.src: - **If all three countries confirm,** the agreement's term is extended for another 16 years.
segments.tr: - **Se todos os três países confirmarem,** o prazo do acordo é estendido por mais 16 anos.

segments.src: - **If any country does not confirm,** the three move to annual joint reviews. The agreement does not end automatically, but it would keep a 2036 expiration date unless the parties later agree to extend it.
segments.tr: - **Se algum país não confirmar,** os três passam a revisões conjuntas anuais. O acordo não termina automaticamente, mas manteria uma data de término em 2036, a menos que as partes concordem posteriormente em estendê-lo.

segments.src: - **Withdrawal is a separate step.** Any country can leave with six months' written notice, but that is a different process from the review.
segments.tr: - **A retirada é uma etapa separada.** Qualquer país pode sair com um aviso prévio por escrito de seis meses, mas esse é um processo diferente da revisão.

segments.src: In short, the review is a checkpoint and a bargaining moment, not a cliff.
segments.tr: Em suma, a revisão é um ponto de controle e um momento de negociação, não um precipício.

segments.src: Still, uncertainty alone can change how companies plan.
segments.tr: Ainda assim, a incerteza por si só pode mudar a forma como as empresas planejam.

segments.tr: - **Segurança econômica,** incluindo como lidar com investimentos e importações de países não membros.

segments.src: ## Why Businesses Are Bracing for Uncertainty
segments.tr: ## Por Que as Empresas Estão se Preparando para a Incerteza

segments.src: Companies make decisions years in advance.
segments.tr: As empresas tomam decisões com anos de antecedência.

segments.src: Building or expanding a plant, signing supplier contracts and setting vehicle prices all depend on a stable set of rules.
segments.tr: Construir ou expandir uma fábrica, assinar contratos com fornecedores e definir preços de veículos dependem de um conjunto estável de regras.

segments.src: When the rules might change, firms tend to respond in familiar ways:
segments.tr: Quando as regras podem mudar, as firmas tendem a responder de maneiras conhecidas:

segments.src: 1. **Delay major investments** until the outlook is clearer.
segments.tr: 1. **Atrasar grandes investimentos** até que a perspectiva esteja mais clara.

segments.src: 2. **Build up inventories** ahead of possible tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. **Acumular estoques** antes de possíveis tarifas.

segments.src: 3. **Diversify suppliers** to reduce reliance on any single border crossing.
segments.tr: 3. **Diversificar fornecedores** para reduzir a dependência de qualquer travessia de fronteira única.

segments.src: 4. **Add price adjustment clauses** to contracts.
segments.tr: 4. **Adicionar cláusulas de ajuste de preço** aos contratos.

segments.src: These steps can themselves affect costs, even before any formal change takes place.
segments.tr: Essas medidas podem, por si só, afetar os custos, mesmo antes que qualquer mudança formal ocorra.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line

segments.src: The USMCA review is about more than diplomacy.
