in.title: Pakta Perdagangan Amerika Utara Sedang Berjalan: Apa Arti Tinjauan USMCA bagi Otomotif, Pertanian, dan Harga

segments.src: The United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement, usually shortened to USMCA, is the rulebook behind most of the goods that cross North American borders.
segments.tr: Perjanjian Amerika Serikat-Meksiko-Kanada, yang biasanya disingkat USMCA, adalah buku aturan di balik sebagian besar barang yang melintasi perbatasan Amerika Utara.

segments.src: It covers everything from pickup trucks and auto parts to dairy, corn, produce and machinery.
segments.tr: Perjanjian ini mencakup segalanya mulai dari truk pikap dan suku cadang mobil hingga produk susu, jagung, hasil bumi, dan mesin.

segments.src: Because the agreement includes a scheduled review, businesses, farmers and shoppers have all been paying close attention to how the three governments handle it.
segments.tr: Karena perjanjian tersebut mencakup tinjauan terjadwal, para pelaku bisnis, petani, dan pembeli telah memperhatikan dengan saksama bagaimana ketiga pemerintah menanganinya.

segments.src: This explainer covers what the review is, what each country wants, and how the outcome could reach car lots, grocery aisles and factory floors.
segments.tr: Penjelasan ini mencakup apa itu tinjauan tersebut, apa yang diinginkan masing-masing negara, dan bagaimana hasilnya dapat memengaruhi tempat penjualan mobil, lorong toko bahan makanan, dan lantai pabrik.

segments.src: Negotiations change quickly, so check current reporting from reliable news outlets for the latest status.
segments.tr: Negosiasi berubah dengan cepat, jadi periksa laporan terkini dari outlet berita tepercaya untuk status terbaru.

segments.src: ## What Is the USMCA Review?
segments.tr: ## Apa Itu Tinjauan USMCA?

segments.src: The USMCA took effect on July 1, 2020, replacing the 1994 North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA).
segments.tr: USMCA mulai berlaku pada 1 Juli 2020, menggantikan Perjanjian Perdagangan Bebas Amerika Utara (NAFTA) tahun 1994.

segments.src: The text includes a "joint review" at the six-year mark, in 2026.
segments.tr: Teks tersebut mencakup "tinjauan bersama" pada tanda enam tahun, pada tahun 2026.

segments.src: At that point each country is asked to confirm in writing whether it wants to extend the agreement's term.
segments.tr: Pada saat itu, setiap negara diminta untuk mengonfirmasi secara tertulis apakah mereka ingin memperpanjang masa berlaku perjanjian tersebut.

segments.src: The mechanics matter more than the headlines suggest:
segments.tr: Mekanismenya lebih penting daripada yang disarankan oleh berita utama:

segments.src: - **If all three countries confirm,** the agreement's term is extended for another 16 years.
segments.tr: - **Jika ketiga negara mengonfirmasi,** masa berlaku perjanjian diperpanjang selama 16 tahun lagi.

segments.src: - **If any country does not confirm,** the three move to annual joint reviews. The agreement does not end automatically, but it would keep a 2036 expiration date unless the parties later agree to extend it.
segments.tr: - **Jika ada negara yang tidak mengonfirmasi,** ketiganya beralih ke tinjauan bersama tahunan. Perjanjian tersebut tidak berakhir secara otomatis, tetapi akan tetap memiliki tanggal kedaluwarsa tahun 2036 kecuali para pihak nantinya setuju untuk memperpanjangnya.

segments.src: - **Withdrawal is a separate step.** Any country can leave with six months' written notice, but that is a different process from the review.
segments.tr: - **Penarikan diri adalah langkah terpisah.** Negara mana pun dapat keluar dengan pemberitahuan tertulis enam bulan sebelumnya, tetapi itu adalah proses yang berbeda dari tinjauan.

segments.src: In short, the review is a checkpoint and a bargaining moment, not a cliff.
segments.tr: Singkatnya, tinjauan tersebut adalah pos pemeriksaan dan momen tawar-menawar, bukan jurang pemisah.

segments.src: Still, uncertainty alone can change how companies plan.
segments.tr: Namun, ketidakpastian saja dapat mengubah cara perusahaan membuat rencana.

segments.src: ## Why So Much Is at Stake
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Begitu Banyak yang Dipertaruhkan

segments.src: North America is one of the most integrated trading regions in the world.
segments.tr: Amerika Utara adalah salah satu kawasan perdagangan paling terintegrasi di dunia.

segments.src: The United States, Canada and Mexico trade well over a trillion dollars in goods with one another each year, and Canada and Mexico rank among the largest export markets for American producers.
segments.tr: Amerika Serikat, Kanada, dan Meksiko memperdagangkan barang senilai lebih dari satu triliun dolar satu sama lain setiap tahun, dan Kanada serta Meksiko termasuk di antara pasar ekspor terbesar bagi produsen Amerika.

segments.src: Many products cross borders several times during manufacturing before they reach a customer.
segments.tr: Banyak produk melintasi perbatasan beberapa kali selama manufaktur sebelum mencapai pelanggan.

segments.src: That integration is why even small rule changes can ripple outward.
segments.tr: Integrasi itulah sebabnya perubahan aturan kecil pun dapat berdampak luas.

segments.src: A tariff or a new paperwork requirement at one border can add cost to a product assembled across all three countries.
segments.tr: Tarif atau persyaratan dokumen baru di satu perbatasan dapat menambah biaya pada produk yang dirakit di ketiga negara.

segments.src: ## Autos: The Biggest Piece of the Puzzle
segments.tr: ## Otomotif: Bagian Terbesar dari Teka-Teki

segments.src: The auto sector is the most closely watched part of the review.
segments.tr: Sektor otomotif adalah bagian yang paling diawasi ketat dalam tinjauan ini.

segments.src: Vehicles and parts are made in a tightly linked supply chain, with engines, transmissions, wiring, seats and electronics moving back and forth across borders.
segments.tr: Kendaraan dan suku cadang dibuat dalam rantai pasokan yang terhubung erat, dengan mesin, transmisi, kabel, kursi, dan elektronik bergerak bolak-balik melintasi perbatasan.

segments.src: Key issues include:
segments.tr: Masalah utama meliputi:

segments.src: - **Rules of origin.** Under current rules, a vehicle generally must have 75% of its content from North America to qualify for duty-free treatment. A share of the work must also be done by workers earning at least $16 an hour. Governments may seek to raise these thresholds or add requirements for specific components such as steel, aluminum and batteries.
segments.tr: - **Aturan asal barang.** Berdasarkan aturan saat ini, kendaraan umumnya harus memiliki 75% kontennya dari Amerika Utara agar memenuhi syarat untuk perlakuan bebas bea. Sebagian pekerjaan juga harus dilakukan oleh pekerja yang berpenghasilan setidaknya $16 per jam. Pemerintah mungkin berupaya menaikkan ambang batas ini atau menambahkan persyaratan untuk komponen tertentu seperti baja, aluminium, dan baterai.

segments.src: - **Non-North American content.** Washington has voiced concern about parts and materials from outside the region, especially from China, entering the supply chain through Mexico or Canada.
segments.tr: - **Konten non-Amerika Utara.** Washington telah menyuarakan kekhawatiran tentang suku cadang dan bahan dari luar kawasan, terutama dari Tiongkok, yang memasuki rantai pasokan melalui Meksiko atau Kanada.

segments.src: - **Tariffs outside the agreement.** Separate U.S. tariffs on autos, auto parts, steel and aluminum have complicated the picture. Automakers want clarity on how those measures interact with USMCA benefits.
segments.tr: - **Tarif di luar perjanjian.** Tarif AS yang terpisah untuk mobil, suku cadang mobil, baja, dan aluminium telah memperumit situasi. Produsen mobil menginginkan kejelasan tentang bagaimana tindakan tersebut berinteraksi dengan manfaat USMCA.

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Automakers can absorb some added costs, pass them to buyers, or reshuffle production.
segments.tr: **Apa artinya bagi harga:** Produsen mobil dapat menyerap beberapa biaya tambahan, membebankannya kepada pembeli, atau mengatur ulang produksi.

segments.src: Any of those choices can affect sticker prices, trim availability and used-car values.
segments.tr: Setiap pilihan tersebut dapat memengaruhi harga stiker, ketersediaan trim, dan nilai mobil bekas.

segments.src: Analysts often note that costs tied to tariffs or stricter origin rules tend to show up gradually rather than all at once.
segments.tr: Analis sering mencatat bahwa biaya yang terkait dengan tarif atau aturan asal yang lebih ketat cenderung muncul secara bertahap daripada sekaligus.

segments.src: ## Farms and Groceries
segments.tr: ## Pertanian dan Bahan Makanan

segments.src: Agriculture is another major area.
segments.tr: Pertanian adalah bidang utama lainnya.

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: AS

segments.src: farmers sell large volumes of corn, soybeans, pork, beef, poultry and dairy to Mexico and Canada, while Americans buy fresh fruit, vegetables, avocados, tomatoes, beer and beef from them in return.
segments.tr: petani menjual jagung, kedelai, daging babi, daging sapi, unggas, dan produk susu dalam jumlah besar ke Meksiko dan Kanada, sementara orang Amerika membeli buah segar, sayuran, alpukat, tomat, bir, dan daging sapi dari mereka sebagai gantinya.

segments.src: Points of friction include:
segments.tr: Poin gesekan meliputi:

segments.src: - **Dairy.** U.S. producers have long argued that Canada's supply-management system limits their access to its market. Canada has defended that system as important to its own farmers.
segments.tr: - **Produk susu.** Produsen AS telah lama berpendapat bahwa sistem manajemen pasokan Kanada membatasi akses mereka ke pasarnya. Kanada telah membela sistem tersebut sebagai sesuatu yang penting bagi petaninya sendiri.

segments.src: - **Biotech corn.** Mexico's policies on genetically engineered corn have been a flashpoint, and a dispute panel previously ruled on part of that issue.
segments.tr: - **Jagung biotek.** Kebijakan Meksiko tentang jagung hasil rekayasa genetika telah menjadi titik api, dan panel sengketa sebelumnya telah memutuskan sebagian dari masalah itu.

segments.src: - **Seasonal produce.** Growers in some U.S. states say imports compete with them during certain months, while shoppers rely on those imports for year-round supply.
segments.tr: - **Produk musiman.** Petani di beberapa negara bagian AS mengatakan impor bersaing dengan mereka selama bulan-bulan tertentu, sementara pembeli mengandalkan impor tersebut untuk pasokan sepanjang tahun.

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Because many fruits and vegetables are imported during the winter, higher tariffs or trade barriers could raise grocery costs or reduce choice in some categories.
segments.tr: **Apa artinya bagi harga:** Karena banyak buah dan sayuran diimpor selama musim dingin, tarif atau hambatan perdagangan yang lebih tinggi dapat menaikkan biaya bahan makanan atau mengurangi pilihan dalam beberapa kategori.

segments.src: On the export side, farmers worry that retaliation by trading partners could lower demand for U.S.
segments.tr: Di sisi ekspor, petani khawatir bahwa pembalasan oleh mitra dagang dapat menurunkan permintaan untuk AS

segments.src: crops and livestock.
segments.tr: tanaman dan ternak.

segments.src: ## Jobs and Factories
segments.tr: ## Pekerjaan dan Pabrik

segments.src: Manufacturing employment is a central argument on every side.
segments.tr: Pekerjaan manufaktur adalah argumen utama di setiap sisi.

segments.src: Supporters of tighter rules say stronger requirements can bring production and jobs to the United States and raise wages.
segments.tr: Pendukung aturan yang lebih ketat mengatakan persyaratan yang lebih kuat dapat membawa produksi dan pekerjaan ke Amerika Serikat dan menaikkan upah.

segments.src: Others caution that making cross-border supply chains more costly could reduce competitiveness against producers in Asia and Europe and put existing jobs at risk.
segments.tr: Yang lain memperingatkan bahwa membuat rantai pasokan lintas batas lebih mahal dapat mengurangi daya saing terhadap produsen di Asia dan Eropa serta membahayakan pekerjaan yang ada.

segments.src: Mexico has an interest in keeping its position as a major manufacturing hub and in attracting investment.
segments.tr: Meksiko memiliki kepentingan untuk mempertahankan posisinya sebagai pusat manufaktur utama dan dalam menarik investasi.

segments.src: Canada, which sends the large majority of its exports south, depends heavily on predictable access to the U.S.
segments.tr: Kanada, yang mengirim sebagian besar ekspornya ke selatan, sangat bergantung pada akses yang dapat diprediksi ke AS

segments.src: market.
segments.tr: pasar.

segments.src: For many communities, a single plant can be a main employer, so decisions about where to invest are watched closely.
segments.tr: Bagi banyak komunitas, satu pabrik bisa menjadi pemberi kerja utama, jadi keputusan tentang di mana harus berinvestasi diawasi dengan ketat.

segments.src: ## Other Topics on the Table
segments.tr: ## Topik Lain di Atas Meja

segments.src: ## What Is the USMCA Review?
segments.tr: ## USMCAの見直しとは？

segments.src: The USMCA took effect on July 1, 2020, replacing the 1994 North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA).
segments.tr: USMCAは2020年7月1日に発効し、1994年の北米自由貿易協定（NAFTA）に置き換わりました。

segments.src: The text includes a "joint review" at the six-year mark, in 2026.
segments.tr: 条文には、6年目にあたる2026年に「共同見直し」を行うことが含まれています。

segments.src: At that point each country is asked to confirm in writing whether it wants to extend the agreement's term.
segments.tr: その時点で、各国は協定の期限を延長するかどうかを書面で確認するよう求められます。

segments.src: The mechanics matter more than the headlines suggest:
segments.tr: 見出しが示唆する以上に、その仕組みが重要となります。

segments.src: - **If all three countries confirm,** the agreement's term is extended for another 16 years.
segments.tr: - **3カ国すべてが確認した場合、**協定の期限はさらに16年間延長されます。

segments.src: - **If any country does not confirm,** the three move to annual joint reviews. The agreement does not end automatically, but it would keep a 2036 expiration date unless the parties later agree to extend it.
segments.tr: - **いずれかの国が確認しない場合、**3カ国は年次共同見扱いに移行します。協定が自動的に終了することはありませんが、当事国が後日延長に合意しない限り、2036年の失効期限が維持されます。

segments.src: - **Withdrawal is a separate step.** Any country can leave with six months' written notice, but that is a different process from the review.
segments.tr: - **脱退は別個の手続きです。**どの国も6か月前の書面による通知により離脱できますが、それは見直しとは異なるプロセスです。

segments.src: In short, the review is a checkpoint and a bargaining moment, not a cliff.
segments.tr: 要するに、見直しは崖っぷちではなく、チェックポイントであり交渉の場です。

segments.src: Still, uncertainty alone can change how companies plan.
segments.tr: それでも、不確実性そのものが企業の計画方法を変える可能性があります。

segments.src: ## Why So Much Is at Stake
segments.tr: ## なぜこれほど多くのものが賭けられているのか

segments.src: North America is one of the most integrated trading regions in the world.
segments.tr: 北米は、世界で最も統合された貿易地域の1つです。

segments.src: The United States, Canada and Mexico trade well over a trillion dollars in goods with one another each year, and Canada and Mexico rank among the largest export markets for American producers.
segments.tr: 米国、カナダ、メキシコは毎年1兆ドルをはるかに超える商品を互いに貿易しており、カナダとメキシコはアメリカの生産者にとって最大の輸出市場の1つに数えられています。

segments.src: Many products cross borders several times during manufacturing before they reach a customer.
segments.tr: 多くの製品は、顧客に届くまでに製造過程で何度も国境を越えます。

segments.src: That integration is why even small rule changes can ripple outward.
segments.tr: そのような統合があるからこそ、小さなルールの変更であっても波及効果を生むのです。

segments.src: A tariff or a new paperwork requirement at one border can add cost to a product assembled across all three countries.
segments.tr: ある国境での関税や新しい書類要件は、3カ国すべてで組み立てられた製品にコストを追加する可能性があります。

segments.src: ## Autos: The Biggest Piece of the Puzzle
segments.tr: ## 自動車：パズルの最大のピース

segments.src: The auto sector is the most closely watched part of the review.
segments.tr: 自動車セクターは、見直しにおいて最も注視されている分野です。

segments.src: Vehicles and parts are made in a tightly linked supply chain, with engines, transmissions, wiring, seats and electronics moving back and forth across borders.
segments.tr: 車両や部品は緊密に結びついたサプライチェーンで製造されており、エンジン、トランスミッション、配線、シート、電子機器が国境を行き来しています。

segments.src: Key issues include:
segments.tr: 主な課題には以下が含まれます。

segments.src: - **Rules of origin.** Under current rules, a vehicle generally must have 75% of its content from North America to qualify for duty-free treatment. A share of the work must also be done by workers earning at least $16 an hour. Governments may seek to raise these thresholds or add requirements for specific components such as steel, aluminum and batteries.
segments.tr: - **原産地規則。**現在の規則の下では、車両が無関税の適用を受けるためには、通常、その内容の75%が北米産である必要があります。作業の一部は、時給16ドル以上を稼ぐ労働者によって行われる必要もあります。政府は、これらの基準を引き上げたり、鉄鋼、アルミニウム、バッテリーなどの特定のコンポーネントに対する要件を追加したりする可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Non-North American content.** Washington has voiced concern about parts and materials from outside the region, especially from China, entering the supply chain through Mexico or Canada.
segments.tr: - **北米外のコンテンツ。**ワシントンは、メキシコやカナダを経由してサプライチェーンに流入する地域外、特に中国からの部品や材料について懸念を表明しています。

segments.src: - **Tariffs outside the agreement.** Separate U.S. tariffs on autos, auto parts, steel and aluminum have complicated the picture. Automakers want clarity on how those measures interact with USMCA benefits.
segments.tr: - **協定外の関税。**自動車、自動車部品、鉄鋼、アルミニウムに対する米国の個別の関税が状況を複雑にしています。自動車メーカーは、それらの措置がUSMCAの恩恵とどのように相互作用するかについての明確性を求めています。

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Automakers can absorb some added costs, pass them to buyers, or reshuffle production.
segments.tr: **価格への影響：**自動車メーカーは追加コストの一部を吸収するか、購入者に転嫁するか、生産を再編することができます。

segments.src: Any of those choices can affect sticker prices, trim availability and used-car values.
segments.tr: それらの選択のいずれも、ステッカー価格、トリムの可用性、中古車の価値に影響を与える可能性があります。

segments.src: Analysts often note that costs tied to tariffs or stricter origin rules tend to show up gradually rather than all at once.
segments.tr: アナリストは、関税やより厳しい原産地規則に関連するコストは、一括してではなく、徐々に現れる傾向があると指摘することがよくあります。

segments.src: ## Farms and Groceries
segments.tr: **農業と食料品**

segments.src: Agriculture is another major area.
segments.tr: 農業はもう一つの主要な分野です。

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: 米国の

segments.src: farmers sell large volumes of corn, soybeans, pork, beef, poultry and dairy to Mexico and Canada, while Americans buy fresh fruit, vegetables, avocados, tomatoes, beer and beef from them in return.
segments.tr: 農家はメキシコとカナダに大量のトウモロコシ、大豆、豚肉、牛肉、鶏肉、乳製品を販売し、アメリカ人はその見返りとして新鮮な果物、野菜、アボカド、トマト、ビール、牛肉をそれらの国から購入しています。

segments.src: Points of friction include:
segments.tr: 摩擦のポイントには以下が含まれます。

segments.src: - **Dairy.** U.S. producers have long argued that Canada's supply-management system limits their access to its market. Canada has defended that system as important to its own farmers.
segments.tr: - **乳製品。**米国の生産者は、カナダの供給管理システムが市場へのアクセスを制限していると長く主張してきました。カナダはそのシステムを自国の農家にとって重要であると擁護してきました。

segments.src: - **Biotech corn.** Mexico's policies on genetically engineered corn have been a flashpoint, and a dispute panel previously ruled on part of that issue.
segments.tr: - **バイオテクノロジーのトウモロコシ。**遺伝子組み換えトウモロコシに関するメキシコの方針は火種となっており、紛争パネルが以前その問題の一部について裁定を下しました。

segments.src: - **Seasonal produce.** Growers in some U.S. states say imports compete with them during certain months, while shoppers rely on those imports for year-round supply.
segments.tr: - **季節限定の農産物。**米国のいくつかの州の生産者は、特定の月に輸入品が自分たちと競合すると主張している一方、買い物客は年間を通じた供給をそれらの輸入品に依存しています。

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Because many fruits and vegetables are imported during the winter, higher tariffs or trade barriers could raise grocery costs or reduce choice in some categories.
segments.tr: **価格への影響：**多くの果物や野菜が冬期に輸入されるため、関税の引き上げや貿易障壁は食料品コストを上昇させたり、一部のカテゴリーでの選択肢を減らしたりする可能性があります。

segments.src: On the export side, farmers worry that retaliation by trading partners could lower demand for U.S.
segments.tr: 輸出側では、農家は貿易相手国による報復が米国の

segments.src: crops and livestock.
segments.tr: 作物や家畜の需要を低下させるのではないかと懸念しています。

segments.src: ## Jobs and Factories
segments.tr: ## 雇用と工場

segments.src: Manufacturing employment is a central argument on every side.
segments.tr: 製造業の雇用は、あらゆる側面における中心的な議論です。

segments.src: Supporters of tighter rules say stronger requirements can bring production and jobs to the United States and raise wages.
segments.tr: より厳しい規則の支持者は、より強力な要件が米国に生産と雇用をもたらし、賃金を引き上げることができると主張しています。

segments.src: Others caution that making cross-border supply chains more costly could reduce competitiveness against producers in Asia and Europe and put existing jobs at risk.
segments.tr: 一方で、国境を越えたサプライチェーンをよりコストのかかるものにすることが、アジアやヨーロッパの生産者に対する競争力を低下させ、既存の雇用を危険にさらす可能性があると警告する声もあります。

segments.src: Mexico has an interest in keeping its position as a major manufacturing hub and in attracting investment.
segments.tr: メキシコには、主要な製造ハブとしての地位を維持し、投資を引き付けることに関心があります。

segments.src: Canada, which sends the large majority of its exports south, depends heavily on predictable access to the U.S.
segments.tr: 輸出の大部分を南方に送るカナダは、米国の市場への予測可能なアクセスに深く依存しています。

segments.src: market.
segments.tr: 市場。

segments.src: For many communities, a single plant can be a main employer, so decisions about where to invest are watched closely.
segments.tr: 多くのコミュニティにとって、1つの工場が主要な雇用主である可能性があるため、どこに投資するかについての決定は注意深く見守られています。

segments.src: ## Other Topics on the Table
segments.tr: ## テーブルの上のその他のトピック

segments.src: The review is not limited to cars and crops.
segments.tr: 見直しは自動車や作物に限定されません。

segments.src: Other issues that have come up include:
segments.tr: 浮上しているその他の問題には以下が含まれます。

segments.src: - **Energy policy,** including the role of state-owned energy companies in Mexico.
segments.tr: - **エネルギー政策：**メキシコにおける国有エネルギー会社の役割を含む。

segments.src: - **Digital trade and online services,** including taxes and data rules.
segments.tr: - **デジタル貿易とオンラインサービス：**税金やデータ規則を含む。

segments.src: - **Labor standards,** such as enforcement of workers' rights in Mexican facilities.
segments.tr: - **労働基準：**メキシコの施設における労働者の権利の執行など。

segments.src: - **Dispute settlement,** and whether the process for resolving trade disagreements is fast and effective enough.
segments.tr: - **紛争解決：**貿易の不一致を解決するためのプロセスが十分迅速かつ効果的であるかどうか。

segments.src: - **Economic security,** including how to handle investment and imports from non-member countries.
segments.tr: - **経済安全保障：**非加盟国からの投資や輸入をどのように処理するかを含む。

segments.src: ## Why Businesses Are Bracing for Uncertainty
segments.tr: ## 企業が不確実性に備えている理由

segments.src: Companies make decisions years in advance.
segments.tr: 企業は数年前に決定を下します。

segments.src: Building or expanding a plant, signing supplier contracts and setting vehicle prices all depend on a stable set of rules.
segments.tr: 工場の建設や拡張、サプライヤーとの契約の締結、車両価格の設定はすべて、安定した一連のルールに依存しています。

segments.src: When the rules might change, firms tend to respond in familiar ways:
segments.tr: ルールが変更される可能性がある場合、企業は慣れ親しんだ方法で対応する傾向があります。

segments.src: 1. **Delay major investments** until the outlook is clearer.
segments.tr: 1. 見通しがより明確になるまで、**主要な投資を延期する**。

segments.src: 2. **Build up inventories** ahead of possible tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. 潜在的な関税に先立って、**在庫を増やす**。

segments.src: 3. **Diversify suppliers** to reduce reliance on any single border crossing.
segments.tr: 3. 単一の国境越えへの依存を減らすために、**サプライヤーを多様化する**。

segments.src: 4. **Add price adjustment clauses** to contracts.
segments.tr: 4. 契約に**価格調整条項を追加する**。

segments.src: These steps can themselves affect costs, even before any formal change takes place.
segments.tr: これらの措置自体が、正式な変更が行われる前であっても、コストに影響を与える可能性があります。

segments.src: ## What Consumers and Workers Can Watch
segments.tr: ## 消費者と労働者が注視できること

segments.src: You do not need to follow every negotiating session to understand the likely effects.
segments.tr: 予想される影響を理解するために、すべての交渉セッションをフォローする必要はありません。

segments.src: A few practical signals can help:
segments.tr: いくつかの実用的なシグナルが役立ちます。

segments.src: - **Official announcements** from the U.S. Trade Representative, Canada's trade ministry and Mexico's Ministry of Economy.
segments.tr: - **米国通商代表部、カナダ貿易省、メキシコ経済省からの公式発表。**

segments.src: - **Automaker and supplier earnings calls,** where executives often discuss expected costs and production plans.
segments.tr: - **自動車メーカーおよびサプライヤーの収益電話会議：**経営幹部が予想されるコストや生産計画について議論することがよくあります。

segments.src: - **Monthly inflation data,** particularly categories such as new vehicles, food and household goods.
segments.tr: - **月次インフレデータ：**特に新車、食料、家庭用品などのカテゴリー。

segments.src: - **Industry groups** for farmers, manufacturers and retailers, which publish their own assessments.
segments.tr: - **農家、製造業者、小売業者向けの業界団体：**独自の評価を公開しています。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## ボトムライン

segments.src: The USMCA review is about more than diplomacy.
segments.tr: USMCAの見直しは、外交以上の問題です。

segments.src: It is a decision about how North American supply chains are governed, and that touches car prices, grocery bills and the jobs tied to cross-border trade.
segments.tr: それは北米のサプライチェーンがどのように管理されるかについての決定であり、それは自動車価格、食料品請求書、および国境を越えた貿易に関連する雇用に触れています。

segments.src: The most likely outcomes range from a straightforward extension to a longer period of annual reviews and negotiated changes.
segments.tr: 最も可能性の高い結果は、単純な延長から、年次見直しの期間の長期化および交渉された変更にまで及びます。

segments.src: In every scenario, the details of the rules, not just the headlines, will determine who gains and who bears the costs.
segments.tr: どのようなシナリオにおいても、見出しだけでなく、ルールの詳細が、誰が得をし、誰がコストを負担するかを決定します。

segments.tr: - **Ursprungsregeln.** Nach den derzeitigen Regeln muss ein Fahrzeug im Allgemeinen zu 75 % aus nordamerikanischer Produktion stammen, um zollfrei behandelt zu werden. Ein Teil der Arbeit muss zudem von Arbeitnehmern geleistet werden, die mindestens 16 Dollar pro Stunde verdienen. Regierungen könnten versuchen, diese Schwellenwerte anzuheben oder Anforderungen für spezifische Komponenten wie Stahl, Aluminium und Batterien hinzuzufügen.

segments.src: - **Non-North American content.** Washington has voiced concern about parts and materials from outside the region, especially from China, entering the supply chain through Mexico or Canada.
segments.tr: - **Nicht-nordamerikanische Inhalte.** Washington hat Bedenken geäußert, dass Teile und Materialien von außerhalb der Region, insbesondere aus China, über Mexiko oder Kanada in die Lieferkette gelangen.

segments.src: - **Tariffs outside the agreement.** Separate U.S. tariffs on autos, auto parts, steel and aluminum have complicated the picture. Automakers want clarity on how those measures interact with USMCA benefits.
segments.tr: - **Zölle außerhalb des Abkommens.** Separate US-Zölle auf Autos, Autoteile, Stahl und Aluminium haben die Situation verkompliziert. Automobilhersteller wünschen sich Klarheit darüber, wie diese Maßnahmen mit den USMCA-Vorteilen interagieren.

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Automakers can absorb some added costs, pass them to buyers, or reshuffle production.
segments.tr: **Was das für die Preise bedeuten könnte:** Automobilhersteller können einige zusätzliche Kosten auffangen, sie an die Käufer weitergeben oder die Produktion umstellen.

segments.src: Any of those choices can affect sticker prices, trim availability and used-car values.
segments.tr: Jede dieser Entscheidungen kann sich auf die Listenpreise, die Verfügbarkeit von Ausstattungsvarianten und die Gebrauchtwagenwerte auswirken.

segments.src: Analysts often note that costs tied to tariffs or stricter origin rules tend to show up gradually rather than all at once.
segments.tr: Analysten merken oft an, dass Kosten, die mit Zöllen oder strengeren Ursprungsregeln verbunden sind, tendenziell eher allmählich als auf einmal sichtbar werden.

segments.src: ## Farms and Groceries
segments.tr: ## Landwirtschaft und Lebensmittel

segments.src: Agriculture is another major area.
segments.tr: Die Landwirtschaft ist ein weiterer wichtiger Bereich.

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: US-

segments.src: farmers sell large volumes of corn, soybeans, pork, beef, poultry and dairy to Mexico and Canada, while Americans buy fresh fruit, vegetables, avocados, tomatoes, beer and beef from them in return.
segments.tr: Landwirte verkaufen große Mengen an Mais, Sojabohnen, Schweinefleisch, Rindfleisch, Geflügel und Milchprodukten nach Mexiko und Kanada, während die Amerikaner im Gegenzug frisches Obst, Gemüse, Avocados, Tomaten, Bier und Rindfleisch von ihnen kaufen.

segments.src: Points of friction include:
segments.tr: Reibungspunkte sind unter anderem:

segments.src: - **Dairy.** U.S. producers have long argued that Canada's supply-management system limits their access to its market. Canada has defended that system as important to its own farmers.
segments.tr: - **Milchprodukte.** US-Produzenten argumentieren seit langem, dass Kanadas System der Angebotssteuerung ihren Zugang zum kanadischen Markt einschränkt. Kanada verteidigt dieses System als wichtig für seine eigenen Landwirte.

segments.src: - **Biotech corn.** Mexico's policies on genetically engineered corn have been a flashpoint, and a dispute panel previously ruled on part of that issue.
segments.tr: - **Biotech-Mais.** Mexikos Politik zu gentechnisch verändertem Mais ist ein Streitpunkt, und ein Streitschlichtungsgremium hat bereits über einen Teil dieses Problems entschieden.

segments.src: - **Seasonal produce.** Growers in some U.S. states say imports compete with them during certain months, while shoppers rely on those imports for year-round supply.
segments.tr: - **Saisonale Erzeugnisse.** Erzeuger in einigen US-Bundesstaaten sagen, dass Importe in bestimmten Monaten mit ihnen konkurrieren, während Verbraucher auf diese Importe für eine ganzjährige Versorgung angewiesen sind.

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Because many fruits and vegetables are imported during the winter, higher tariffs or trade barriers could raise grocery costs or reduce choice in some categories.
segments.tr: **Was das für die Preise bedeuten könnte:** Da viele Obst- und Gemüsesorten im Winter importiert werden, könnten höhere Zölle oder Handelshemmnisse die Lebensmittelkosten erhöhen oder die Auswahl in einigen Kategorien verringern.

segments.src: On the export side, farmers worry that retaliation by trading partners could lower demand for U.S.
segments.tr: Auf der Exportseite befürchten Landwirte, dass Vergeltungsmaßnahmen der Handelspartner die Nachfrage nach US-

segments.src: crops and livestock.
segments.tr: Agrarprodukten und Viehbestand senken könnten.

segments.src: ## Jobs and Factories
segments.tr: ## Arbeitsplätze und Fabriken

segments.src: Manufacturing employment is a central argument on every side.
segments.tr: Die Beschäftigung im verarbeitenden Gewerbe ist ein zentrales Argument auf allen Seiten.

segments.src: Supporters of tighter rules say stronger requirements can bring production and jobs to the United States and raise wages.
segments.tr: Befürworter strengerer Regeln sagen, dass stärkere Anforderungen die Produktion und Arbeitsplätze in die Vereinigten Staaten zurückbringen und die Löhne erhöhen können.

segments.src: Others caution that making cross-border supply chains more costly could reduce competitiveness against producers in Asia and Europe and put existing jobs at risk.
segments.tr: Andere warnen, dass eine Verteuerung grenzüberschreitender Lieferketten die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit gegenüber Produzenten in Asien und Europa verringern und bestehende Arbeitsplätze gefährden könnte.

segments.src: Mexico has an interest in keeping its position as a major manufacturing hub and in attracting investment.
segments.tr: Mexiko hat ein Interesse daran, seine Position als wichtiges Produktionszentrum zu behalten und Investitionen anzuziehen.

segments.src: Canada, which sends the large majority of its exports south, depends heavily on predictable access to the U.S.
segments.tr: Kanada, das den Großteil seiner Exporte in den Süden schickt, ist stark auf einen vorhersehbaren Zugang zum US-

segments.src: market.
segments.tr: Markt angewiesen.

segments.src: For many communities, a single plant can be a main employer, so decisions about where to invest are watched closely.
segments.tr: Für viele Gemeinden kann ein einzelnes Werk ein Hauptarbeitgeber sein, daher werden Entscheidungen über Investitionsstandorte genau beobachtet.

segments.src: ## Other Topics on the Table
segments.tr: ## Weitere Themen auf dem Tisch

segments.src: The review is not limited to cars and crops.
segments.tr: Die Überprüfung beschränkt sich nicht nur auf Autos und landwirtschaftliche Erzeugnisse.

segments.src: Other issues that have come up include:
segments.tr: Andere Themen, die aufgekommen sind, umfassen:

segments.src: - **Energy policy,** including the role of state-owned energy companies in Mexico.
segments.tr: - **Energiepolitik,** einschließlich der Rolle staatlicher Energieunternehmen in Mexiko.

segments.src: - **Digital trade and online services,** including taxes and data rules.
segments.tr: - **Digitaler Handel und Online-Dienste,** einschließlich Steuern und Datenregeln.

segments.src: - **Labor standards,** such as enforcement of workers' rights in Mexican facilities.
segments.tr: - **Arbeitsstandards,** wie die Durchsetzung von Arbeitnehmerrechten in mexikanischen Einrichtungen.

segments.src: - **Dispute settlement,** and whether the process for resolving trade disagreements is fast and effective enough.
segments.tr: - **Streitbeilegung,** und ob der Prozess zur Lösung von Handelsstreitigkeiten schnell und effektiv genug ist.

segments.src: - **Economic security,** including how to handle investment and imports from non-member countries.
segments.tr: - **Wirtschaftssicherheit,** einschließlich des Umgangs mit Investitionen und Importen aus Nicht-Mitgliedsländern.

segments.src: ## Why Businesses Are Bracing for Uncertainty
segments.tr: ## Warum sich Unternehmen auf Unsicherheit einstellen

segments.src: Companies make decisions years in advance.
segments.tr: Unternehmen treffen Entscheidungen Jahre im Voraus.

segments.src: Building or expanding a plant, signing supplier contracts and setting vehicle prices all depend on a stable set of rules.
segments.tr: Der Bau oder die Erweiterung eines Werks, das Unterzeichnen von Lieferantenverträgen und die Festlegung von Fahrzeugpreisen hängen alle von stabilen Regeln ab.

segments.src: When the rules might change, firms tend to respond in familiar ways:
segments.tr: Wenn sich die Regeln ändern könnten, reagieren Firmen meist auf bekannte Weise:

segments.src: 1. **Delay major investments** until the outlook is clearer.
segments.tr: 1. **Große Investitionen aufschieben,** bis die Aussichten klarer sind.

segments.src: 2. **Build up inventories** ahead of possible tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. **Lagerbestände aufbauen,** im Vorgriff auf mögliche Zölle.

segments.src: 3. **Diversify suppliers** to reduce reliance on any single border crossing.
segments.tr: 3. **Lieferanten diversifizieren,** um die Abhängigkeit von einem einzelnen Grenzübergang zu verringern.

segments.src: 4. **Add price adjustment clauses** to contracts.
segments.tr: 4. **Preisanpassungsklauseln** in Verträge aufnehmen.

segments.src: These steps can themselves affect costs, even before any formal change takes place.
segments.tr: Diese Schritte können sich selbst auf die Kosten auswirken, noch bevor eine formelle Änderung stattfindet.

segments.src: ## What Consumers and Workers Can Watch
segments.tr: ## Worauf Verbraucher und Arbeitnehmer achten können

segments.src: You do not need to follow every negotiating session to understand the likely effects.
segments.tr: Sie müssen nicht jede Verhandlungssitzung verfolgen, um die wahrscheinlichen Auswirkungen zu verstehen.

segments.src: A few practical signals can help:
segments.tr: Ein paar praktische Signale können helfen:

segments.src: - **Official announcements** from the U.S. Trade Representative, Canada's trade ministry and Mexico's Ministry of Economy.
segments.tr: - **Offizielle Ankündigungen** des US-Handelsbeauftragten, des kanadischen Handelsministeriums und des mexikanischen Wirtschaftsministeriums.

segments.src: - **Automaker and supplier earnings calls,** where executives often discuss expected costs and production plans.
segments.tr: - **Earnings Calls von Automobilherstellern und Zulieferern,** bei denen Führungskräfte oft über erwartete Kosten und Produktionspläne sprechen.

segments.src: - **Monthly inflation data,** particularly categories such as new vehicles, food and household goods.
segments.tr: - **Monatliche Inflationsdaten,** insbesondere für Kategorien wie Neuwagen, Lebensmittel und Haushaltswaren.

segments.src: - **Industry groups** for farmers, manufacturers and retailers, which publish their own assessments.
segments.tr: - **Branchenverbände** für Landwirte, Hersteller und Einzelhändler, die ihre eigenen Einschätzungen veröffentlichen.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The USMCA review is about more than diplomacy.
segments.tr: Bei der USMCA-Überprüfung geht es um mehr als Diplomatie.

segments.src: It is a decision about how North American supply chains are governed, and that touches car prices, grocery bills and the jobs tied to cross-border trade.
segments.tr: Es ist eine Entscheidung darüber, wie nordamerikanische Lieferketten gesteuert werden, und das betrifft Autopreise, Lebensmittelrechnungen und die Arbeitsplätze, die mit dem grenzüberschreitenden Handel verbunden sind.

segments.src: The most likely outcomes range from a straightforward extension to a longer period of annual reviews and negotiated changes.
segments.tr: Die wahrscheinlichsten Ergebnisse reichen von einer einfachen Verlängerung bis hin zu einem längeren Zeitraum jährlicher Überprüfungen und ausgehandelter Änderungen.

segments.src: In every scenario, the details of the rules, not just the headlines, will determine who gains and who bears the costs.
segments.tr: In jedem Szenario werden die Details der Regeln, nicht nur die Schlagzeilen, darüber entscheiden, wer gewinnt und wer die Kosten trägt.

vi.title: Hiệp định Thương mại Bắc Mỹ sắp đến hạn: Đánh giá USMCA có ý nghĩa gì đối với ô tô, nông nghiệp và giá cả

segments.src: The United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement, usually shortened to USMCA, is the rulebook behind most of the goods that cross North American borders.
segments.tr: Hiệp định Hoa Kỳ - Mexico - Canada, thường được gọi tắt là USMCA, là bộ quy tắc đằng sau hầu hết các hàng hóa vượt qua biên giới Bắc Mỹ.

segments.src: It covers everything from pickup trucks and auto parts to dairy, corn, produce and machinery.
segments.tr: Hiệp định này bao gồm mọi thứ từ xe bán tải và phụ tùng ô tô đến các sản phẩm sữa, ngô, nông sản và máy móc.

segments.src: Because the agreement includes a scheduled review, businesses, farmers and shoppers have all been paying close attention to how the three governments handle it.
segments.tr: Vì hiệp định bao gồm một cuộc đánh giá theo lịch trình, các doanh nghiệp, nông dân và người mua sắm đều theo dõi rất sát sao cách ba chính phủ xử lý vấn đề này.

segments.src: This explainer covers what the review is, what each country wants, and how the outcome could reach car lots, grocery aisles and factory floors.
segments.tr: Bài viết giải thích này đề cập đến việc đánh giá là gì, mỗi quốc gia muốn gì và kết quả có thể tác động như thế nào đến các bãi đậu xe, lối đi siêu thị và nhà máy.

segments.src: Negotiations change quickly, so check current reporting from reliable news outlets for the latest status.
segments.tr: Các cuộc đàm phán thay đổi nhanh chóng, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra các bản tin hiện tại từ các hãng thông tấn đáng tin cậy để biết trạng thái mới nhất.

segments.src: ## What Is the USMCA Review?
segments.tr: ## Đánh giá USMCA là gì?

segments.src: The USMCA took effect on July 1, 2020, replacing the 1994 North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA).
segments.tr: USMCA có hiệu lực vào ngày 1 tháng 7 năm 2020, thay thế Hiệp định Thương mại Tự do Bắc Mỹ (NAFTA) năm 1994.

segments.src: The text includes a "joint review" at the six-year mark, in 2026.
segments.tr: Văn bản bao gồm một "đánh giá chung" vào mốc sáu năm, vào năm 2026.

segments.src: At that point each country is asked to confirm in writing whether it wants to extend the agreement's term.
segments.tr: Tại thời điểm đó, mỗi quốc gia được yêu cầu xác nhận bằng văn bản xem họ có muốn gia hạn thời hạn của hiệp định hay không.

segments.src: The mechanics matter more than the headlines suggest:
segments.tr: Cơ chế quan trọng hơn những gì các tiêu đề gợi ý:

segments.src: - **If all three countries confirm,** the agreement's term is extended for another 16 years.
segments.tr: - **Nếu cả ba quốc gia đều xác nhận,** thời hạn của hiệp định được kéo dài thêm 16 năm.

segments.src: - **If any country does not confirm,** the three move to annual joint reviews. The agreement does not end automatically, but it would keep a 2036 expiration date unless the parties later agree to extend it.
segments.tr: - **Nếu bất kỳ quốc gia nào không xác nhận,** ba nước chuyển sang đánh giá chung hàng năm. Hiệp định không tự động chấm dứt, nhưng nó sẽ giữ thời hạn hết hạn vào năm 2036 trừ khi các bên sau đó đồng ý gia hạn.

segments.src: - **Withdrawal is a separate step.** Any country can leave with six months' written notice, but that is a different process from the review.
segments.tr: - **Việc rút lui là một bước riêng biệt.** Bất kỳ quốc gia nào cũng có thể rời đi với thông báo bằng văn bản trước sáu tháng, nhưng đó là một quy trình khác với việc đánh giá.

segments.src: In short, the review is a checkpoint and a bargaining moment, not a cliff.
segments.tr: Tóm lại, việc đánh giá là một cột mốc và một thời điểm thương lượng, không phải là một vực thẳm.

segments.src: Still, uncertainty alone can change how companies plan.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, bản thân sự bất định có thể thay đổi cách các công ty lên kế hoạch.

segments.src: ## Why So Much Is at Stake
segments.tr: ## Tại sao lại có nhiều rủi ro đến vậy

segments.src: North America is one of the most integrated trading regions in the world.
segments.tr: Bắc Mỹ là một trong những khu vực thương mại hội nhập nhất trên thế giới.

segments.src: The United States, Canada and Mexico trade well over a trillion dollars in goods with one another each year, and Canada and Mexico rank among the largest export markets for American producers.
segments.tr: Hoa Kỳ, Canada và Mexico giao thương hơn một nghìn tỷ đô la hàng hóa với nhau mỗi năm, và Canada và Mexico nằm trong số các thị trường xuất khẩu lớn nhất của các nhà sản xuất Hoa Kỳ.

segments.src: Many products cross borders several times during manufacturing before they reach a customer.
segments.tr: Nhiều sản phẩm vượt qua biên giới nhiều lần trong quá trình sản xuất trước khi đến tay khách hàng.

segments.src: That integration is why even small rule changes can ripple outward.
segments.tr: Sự hội nhập đó là lý do tại sao ngay cả những thay đổi quy tắc nhỏ cũng có thể tạo ra hiệu ứng lan tỏa.

segments.src: A tariff or a new paperwork requirement at one border can add cost to a product assembled across all three countries.
segments.tr: Thuế quan hoặc yêu cầu thủ tục giấy tờ mới tại một biên giới có thể làm tăng chi phí cho một sản phẩm được lắp ráp trên cả ba quốc gia.

segments.src: ## Autos: The Biggest Piece of the Puzzle
segments.tr: ## Ô tô: Phần lớn nhất của câu đố

segments.src: The auto sector is the most closely watched part of the review.
segments.tr: Ngành công nghiệp ô tô là phần được theo dõi chặt chẽ nhất trong cuộc đánh giá.

segments.src: Vehicles and parts are made in a tightly linked supply chain, with engines, transmissions, wiring, seats and electronics moving back and forth across borders.
segments.tr: Xe cộ và phụ tùng được sản xuất trong một chuỗi cung ứng liên kết chặt chẽ, với động cơ, hộp số, hệ thống dây điện, ghế ngồi và thiết bị điện tử di chuyển qua lại giữa các biên giới.

segments.src: Key issues include:
segments.tr: Các vấn đề chính bao gồm:

segments.src: - **Rules of origin.** Under current rules, a vehicle generally must have 75% of its content from North America to qualify for duty-free treatment. A share of the work must also be done by workers earning at least $16 an hour. Governments may seek to raise these thresholds or add requirements for specific components such as steel, aluminum and batteries.
segments.tr: - **Quy tắc xuất xứ.** Theo các quy tắc hiện hành, một chiếc xe nhìn chung phải có 75% hàm lượng từ Bắc Mỹ để đủ điều kiện hưởng ưu đãi miễn thuế. Một phần công việc cũng phải được thực hiện bởi những công nhân kiếm được ít nhất 16 đô la một giờ. Các chính phủ có thể tìm cách nâng cao các ngưỡng này hoặc bổ sung các yêu cầu đối với các linh kiện cụ thể như thép, nhôm và pin.

segments.src: - **Non-North American content.** Washington has voiced concern about parts and materials from outside the region, especially from China, entering the supply chain through Mexico or Canada.
segments.tr: - **Hàm lượng ngoài Bắc Mỹ.** Washington đã bày tỏ lo ngại về các bộ phận và vật liệu từ bên ngoài khu vực, đặc biệt là từ Trung Quốc, thâm nhập vào chuỗi cung ứng thông qua Mexico hoặc Canada.

segments.src: - **Tariffs outside the agreement.** Separate U.S. tariffs on autos, auto parts, steel and aluminum have complicated the picture. Automakers want clarity on how those measures interact with USMCA benefits.
segments.tr: - **Thuế quan bên ngoài hiệp định.** Các mức thuế riêng của Hoa Kỳ đối với ô tô, phụ tùng ô tô, thép và nhôm đã làm phức tạp thêm bức tranh. Các nhà sản xuất ô tô muốn có sự rõ ràng về cách các biện pháp đó tương tác với các lợi ích của USMCA.

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Automakers can absorb some added costs, pass them to buyers, or reshuffle production.
segments.tr: **Ý nghĩa có thể có đối với giá cả:** Các nhà sản xuất ô tô có thể gánh chịu một số chi phí gia tăng, chuyển chúng cho người mua hoặc xáo trộn sản xuất.

segments.src: Any of those choices can affect sticker prices, trim availability and used-car values.
segments.tr: Bất kỳ lựa chọn nào trong số đó đều có thể ảnh hưởng đến giá niêm yết, tính sẵn có của phiên bản xe và giá trị xe đã qua sử dụng.

segments.src: Analysts often note that costs tied to tariffs or stricter origin rules tend to show up gradually rather than all at once.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích thường lưu ý rằng chi phí gắn liền với thuế quan hoặc các quy tắc xuất xứ nghiêm ngặt hơn có xu hướng xuất hiện dần dần thay vì tất cả cùng một lúc.

segments.src: ## Farms and Groceries
segments.tr: ## Nông trại và Thực phẩm

segments.src: Agriculture is another major area.
segments.tr: Nông nghiệp là một lĩnh vực lớn khác.

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: Nông dân

segments.src: farmers sell large volumes of corn, soybeans, pork, beef, poultry and dairy to Mexico and Canada, while Americans buy fresh fruit, vegetables, avocados, tomatoes, beer and beef from them in return.
segments.tr: Hoa Kỳ bán khối lượng lớn ngô, đậu nành, thịt lợn, thịt bò, gia cầm và các sản phẩm sữa cho Mexico và Canada, trong khi người Mỹ mua trái cây tươi, rau, bơ, cà chua, bia và thịt bò từ họ để đổi lại.

segments.src: Points of friction include:
segments.tr: Các điểm ma sát bao gồm:

segments.src: - **Dairy.** U.S. producers have long argued that Canada's supply-management system limits their access to its market. Canada has defended that system as important to its own farmers.
segments.tr: - **Sữa.** Các nhà sản xuất Hoa Kỳ từ lâu đã lập luận rằng hệ thống quản lý nguồn cung của Canada hạn chế quyền tiếp cận thị trường của họ. Canada đã bảo vệ hệ thống đó vì nó quan trọng đối với nông dân của chính họ.

segments.src: - **Biotech corn.** Mexico's policies on genetically engineered corn have been a flashpoint, and a dispute panel previously ruled on part of that issue.
segments.tr: - **Ngô công nghệ sinh học.** Các chính sách của Mexico về ngô biến đổi gen đã trở thành một điểm nóng, và một hội đồng tranh chấp trước đó đã đưa ra phán quyết về một phần của vấn đề đó.

segments.src: - **Seasonal produce.** Growers in some U.S. states say imports compete with them during certain months, while shoppers rely on those imports for year-round supply.
segments.tr: - **Nông sản theo mùa.** Những người trồng trọt ở một số tiểu bang của Hoa Kỳ cho biết hàng nhập khẩu cạnh tranh với họ trong những tháng nhất định, trong khi người mua sắm dựa vào hàng nhập khẩu đó để có nguồn cung quanh năm.

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Because many fruits and vegetables are imported during the winter, higher tariffs or trade barriers could raise grocery costs or reduce choice in some categories.
segments.tr: **Ý nghĩa có thể có đối với giá cả:** Vì nhiều loại trái cây và rau quả được nhập khẩu trong mùa đông, thuế quan cao hơn hoặc rào cản thương mại có thể làm tăng chi phí tạp hóa hoặc giảm sự lựa chọn ở một số danh mục.

segments.src: On the export side, farmers worry that retaliation by trading partners could lower demand for U.S.
segments.tr: Về phía xuất khẩu, nông dân lo lắng rằng việc trả đũa của các đối tác thương mại có thể làm giảm nhu cầu đối với cây trồng và vật nuôi của

segments.src: crops and livestock.
segments.tr: Hoa Kỳ.

segments.src: ## Jobs and Factories
segments.tr: ## Việc làm và Nhà máy

segments.src: Manufacturing employment is a central argument on every side.
segments.tr: Việc làm trong ngành sản xuất là một lập luận trọng tâm ở mọi phía.

segments.src: Supporters of tighter rules say stronger requirements can bring production and jobs to the United States and raise wages.
segments.tr: Những người ủng hộ các quy tắc chặt chẽ hơn nói rằng các yêu cầu mạnh mẽ hơn có thể mang lại sản xuất và việc làm cho Hoa Kỳ và nâng cao tiền lương.

segments.src: Others caution that making cross-border supply chains more costly could reduce competitiveness against producers in Asia and Europe and put existing jobs at risk.
segments.tr: Những người khác cảnh báo rằng việc làm cho chuỗi cung ứng xuyên biên giới tốn kém hơn có thể làm giảm khả năng cạnh tranh với các nhà sản xuất ở Châu Á và Châu Âu và đặt các ệc làm hiện tại vào tình trạng rủi ro.

segments.src: Mexico has an interest in keeping its position as a major manufacturing hub and in attracting investment.
segments.tr: Mexico có lợi ích trong việc giữ vững vị trí là một trung tâm sản xuất lớn và thu hút đầu tư.

segments.src: Canada, which sends the large majority of its exports south, depends heavily on predictable access to the U.S.
segments.tr: Canada, quốc gia gửi phần lớn hàng xuất khẩu của mình về phía nam, phụ thuộc rất nhiều vào quyền tiếp cận có thể dự đoán được đối với thị trường

segments.src: market.
segments.tr: Hoa Kỳ.

segments.src: For many communities, a single plant can be a main employer, so decisions about where to invest are watched closely.
segments.tr: Đối với nhiều cộng đồng, một nhà máy duy nhất có thể là nhà tuyển dụng chính, vì vậy các quyết định về nơi đầu tư được theo dõi chặt chẽ.

segments.src: ## Other Topics on the Table
segments.tr: ## Các chủ đề khác trên bàn đàm phán

segments.src: The review is not limited to cars and crops.
segments.tr: Cuộc đánh giá không chỉ giới hạn ở ô tô và cây trồng.

segments.src: Other issues that have come up include:
segments.tr: Các vấn đề khác đã nảy sinh bao gồm:

segments.src: - **Energy policy,** including the role of state-owned energy companies in Mexico.
segments.tr: - **Chính sách năng lượng,** bao gồm vai trò của các công ty năng lượng thuộc sở hữu nhà nước ở Mexico.

segments.src: - **Digital trade and online services,** including taxes and data rules.
segments.tr: - **Thương mại kỹ thuật số và dịch vụ trực tuyến,** bao gồm thuế và các quy tắc dữ liệu.

segments.src: - **Labor standards,** such as enforcement of workers' rights in Mexican facilities.
segments.tr: - **Tiêu chuẩn lao động,** chẳng hạn như việc thực thi quyền của người lao động tại các cơ sở ở Mexico.

segments.src: - **Dispute settlement,** and whether the process for resolving trade disagreements is fast and effective enough.
segments.tr: - **Giải quyết tranh chấp,** và liệu quy trình giải quyết các bất đồng thương mại có đủ nhanh chóng và hiệu quả hay không.

segments.src: - **Economic security,** including how to handle investment and imports from non-member countries.
segments.tr: - **An ninh kinh tế,** bao gồm cách xử lý đầu tư và nhập khẩu từ các quốc gia không phải thành viên.

segments.src: ## Why Businesses Are Bracing for Uncertainty
segments.tr: ## Tại sao các doanh nghiệp đang chuẩn bị tinh thần cho sự bất định

segments.src: Companies make decisions years in advance.
segments.tr: Các công ty đưa ra quyết định trước nhiều năm.

segments.src: Building or expanding a plant, signing supplier contracts and setting vehicle prices all depend on a stable set of rules.
segments.tr: Xây dựng hoặc mở rộng nhà máy, ký hợp đồng nhà cung cấp và thiết lập giá xe đều phụ thuộc vào một tập hợp các quy tắc ổn định.

segments.src: When the rules might change, firms tend to respond in familiar ways:
segments.tr: Khi các quy tắc có thể thay đổi, các công ty có xu hướng phản ứng theo những cách quen thuộc:

segments.src: 1. **Delay major investments** until the outlook is clearer.
segments.tr: 1. **Trì hoãn các khoản đầu tư lớn** cho đến khi triển vọng rõ ràng hơn.

segments.src: 2. **Build up inventories** ahead of possible tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. **Tăng hàng tồn kho** trước khả năng áp thuế.

segments.src: 3. **Diversify suppliers** to reduce reliance on any single border crossing.
segments.tr: 3. **Đa dạng hóa nhà cung cấp** để giảm sự phụ thuộc vào bất kỳ điểm vượt biên giới nào.

segments.src: 4. **Add price adjustment clauses** to contracts.
segments.tr: 4. **Thêm các điều khoản điều chỉnh giá** vào hợp đồng.

segments.src: These steps can themselves affect costs, even before any formal change takes place.
segments.tr: Bản thân các bước này có thể ảnh hưởng đến chi phí, thậm chí trước khi bất kỳ thay đổi chính thức nào diễn ra.

segments.src: ## What Consumers and Workers Can Watch
segments.tr: ## Người tiêu dùng và Người lao động có thể theo dõi những gì

segments.src: You do not need to follow every negotiating session to understand the likely effects.
segments.tr: Bạn không cần phải theo dõi mọi phiên đàm phán để hiểu các tác động có thể xảy ra.

segments.src: A few practical signals can help:
segments.tr: Một vài tín hiệu thực tế có thể giúp ích:

segments.src: - **Official announcements** from the U.S. Trade Representative, Canada's trade ministry and Mexico's Ministry of Economy.
segments.tr: - **Thông báo chính thức** từ Đại diện Thương mại Hoa Kỳ, Bộ Thương mại Canada và Bộ Kinh tế Mexico.

segments.src: - **Automaker and supplier earnings calls,** where executives often discuss expected costs and production plans.
segments.tr: - **Cuộc gọi báo cáo thu nhập của nhà sản xuất ô tô và nhà cung cấp,** nơi các giám đốc điều hành thường thảo luận về chi phí dự kiến và kế hoạch sản xuất.

segments.src: - **Monthly inflation data,** particularly categories such as new vehicles, food and household goods.
segments.tr: - **Dữ liệu lạm phát hàng tháng,** đặc biệt là các danh mục như xe mới, thực phẩm và hàng hóa gia dụng.

segments.src: - **Industry groups** for farmers, manufacturers and retailers, which publish their own assessments.
segments.tr: - **Các nhóm ngành** dành cho nông dân, nhà sản xuất và nhà bán lẻ, xuất bản các đánh giá của riêng họ.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: The USMCA review is about more than diplomacy.
segments.tr: Đánh giá USMCA không chỉ là ngoại giao.

segments.src: It is a decision about how North American supply chains are governed, and that touches car prices, grocery bills and the jobs tied to cross-border trade.
segments.tr: Đó là quyết định về cách quản lý chuỗi cung ứng Bắc Mỹ, và điều đó chạm đến giá xe, hóa đơn tạp hóa và việc làm gắn liền với thương mại xuyên biên giới.

segments.src: The most likely outcomes range from a straightforward extension to a longer period of annual reviews and negotiated changes.
segments.tr: Kết quả có nhiều khả năng xảy ra nhất dao động từ việc gia hạn trực tiếp đến thời gian đánh giá hàng năm dài hơn và các thay đổi được đàm phán.

segments.src: In every scenario, the details of the rules, not just the headlines, will determine who gains and who bears the costs.
segments.tr: Trong mọi kịch bản, chi tiết của các quy tắc, chứ không chỉ là các tiêu đề, sẽ quyết định ai đạt được lợi ích và ai gánh chịu chi phí.

segments.tr: *Bài viết này chỉ mang tính chất thông tin chung và không phải là lời khuyên tài chính, đầu tư hoặc pháp lý.

segments.tr: Chính sách thương mại đang phát triển, và các số liệu cũng như quan điểm có thể đã thay đổi kể từ khi xuất bản.*

ar.title: اتفاقية التجارة في أمريكا الشمالية قيد المراجعة: ماذا يعني مراجعة اتفاقية USMCA للسيارات والمزارع والأسعار

segments.src: The United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement, usually shortened to USMCA, is the rulebook behind most of the goods that cross North American borders.
segments.tr: اتفاقية الولايات المتحدة والمكسيك وكندا، والتي تُختصر عادةً بـ USMCA، هي كتاب القواعد الذي يحكم معظم السلع التي تعبر حدود أمريكا الشمالية.

segments.src: It covers everything from pickup trucks and auto parts to dairy, corn, produce and machinery.
segments.tr: وهي تغطي كل شيء بدءاً من الشاحنات الصغيرة وقطع غيار السيارات وصولاً إلى منتجات الألبان والذرة والمنتجات الزراعية والآلات.

segments.src: Because the agreement includes a scheduled review, businesses, farmers and shoppers have all been paying close attention to how the three governments handle it.
segments.tr: ولأن الاتفاقية تتضمن مراجعة مجدولة، فإن الشركات والمزارعين والمتسوقين يراقبون جميعاً عن كثب كيفية تعامل الحكومات الثلاث معها.

segments.src: This explainer covers what the review is, what each country wants, and how the outcome could reach car lots, grocery aisles and factory floors.
segments.tr: يوضح هذا الشرح ماهية المراجعة، وما تريده كل دولة، وكيف يمكن أن تؤثر النتائج على ساحات بيع السيارات وممرات البقالة وأرضيات المصانع.

segments.src: Negotiations change quickly, so check current reporting from reliable news outlets for the latest status.
segments.tr: تتغير المفاوضات بسرعة، لذا تحقق من التقارير الحالية من مصادر إخبارية موثوقة لمعرفة أحدث المستجدات.

segments.src: ## What Is the USMCA Review?
segments.tr: ## ما هي مراجعة اتفاقية USMCA؟

segments.src: The USMCA took effect on July 1, 2020, replacing the 1994 North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA).
segments.tr: دخلت اتفاقية USMCA حيز التنفيذ في 1 يوليو 2020، لتحل محل اتفاقية التجارة الحرة لأمريكا الشمالية (NAFTA) لعام 1994.

segments.src: The text includes a "joint review" at the six-year mark, in 2026.
segments.tr: يتضمن النص "مراجعة مشتركة" في علامة الست سنوات، في عام 2026.

segments.src: At that point each country is asked to confirm in writing whether it wants to extend the agreement's term.
segments.tr: في تلك المرحلة، يُطلب من كل دولة تأكيد ما إذا كانت ترغب في تمديد فترة الاتفاقية كتابياً.

segments.src: The mechanics matter more than the headlines suggest:
segments.tr: آليات العمل أكثر أهمية مما تشير إليه العناوين الرئيسية:

segments.src: - **If all three countries confirm,** the agreement's term is extended for another 16 years.
segments.tr: - **إذا أكدت الدول الثلاث،** يتم تمديد فترة الاتفاقية لمدة 16 عاماً أخرى.

segments.src: - **If any country does not confirm,** the three move to annual joint reviews. The agreement does not end automatically, but it would keep a 2036 expiration date unless the parties later agree to extend it.
segments.tr: - **إذا لم تؤكد أي دولة،** تنتقل الدول الثلاث إلى مراجعات مشتركة سنوية. لا تنتهي الاتفاقية تلقائياً، ولكنها ستحتفظ بتاريخ انتهاء في عام 2036 ما لم يتفق الأطراف لاحقاً على تمديدها.

segments.src: - **Withdrawal is a separate step.** Any country can leave with six months' written notice, but that is a different process from the review.
segments.tr: - **الانسحاب هو خطوة منفصلة.** يمكن لأي دولة المغادرة بإخطار كتابي قبل ستة أشهر، لكن هذه عملية مختلفة عن المراجعة.

segments.src: In short, the review is a checkpoint and a bargaining moment, not a cliff.
segments.tr: باختصار، المراجعة هي نقطة تفتيش ولحظة تفاوض، وليست حافة هاوية.

segments.src: Still, uncertainty alone can change how companies plan.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، فإن عدم اليقين وحده يمكن أن يغير كيفية تخطيط الشركات.

segments.src: ## Why So Much Is at Stake
segments.tr: ## لماذا هناك الكثير على المحك

segments.src: North America is one of the most integrated trading regions in the world.
segments.tr: تعد أمريكا الشمالية واحدة من أكثر مناطق التجارة تكاملاً في العالم.

segments.src: The United States, Canada and Mexico trade well over a trillion dollars in goods with one another each year, and Canada and Mexico rank among the largest export markets for American producers.
segments.tr: تتبادل الولايات المتحدة وكندا والمكسيك سلعاً تزيد قيمتها عن تريليون دولار مع بعضها البعض كل عام، وتُصنف كندا والمكسيك من بين أكبر أسواق التصدير للمنتجين الأمريكيين.

segments.src: Many products cross borders several times during manufacturing before they reach a customer.
segments.tr: تعبر العديد من المنتجات الحدود عدة مرات أثناء التصنيع قبل أن تصل إلى العميل.

segments.src: That integration is why even small rule changes can ripple outward.
segments.tr: هذا التكامل هو السبب في أن حتى التغييرات الصغيرة في القواعد يمكن أن يكون لها تأثيرات ممتدة.

segments.src: A tariff or a new paperwork requirement at one border can add cost to a product assembled across all three countries.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تؤدي تعريفة جمركية أو متطلبات أوراق جديدة عند حدود واحدة إلى زيادة تكلفة منتج يتم تجميعه عبر الدول الثلاث.

segments.src: ## Autos: The Biggest Piece of the Puzzle
segments.tr: ## السيارات: الجزء الأكبر من اللغز

segments.src: The auto sector is the most closely watched part of the review.
segments.tr: قطاع السيارات هو الجزء الأكثر مراقبة في المراجعة.

segments.src: Vehicles and parts are made in a tightly linked supply chain, with engines, transmissions, wiring, seats and electronics moving back and forth across borders.
segments.tr: يتم تصنيع المركبات وقطع الغيار في سلسلة توريد مترابطة بشكل وثيق، مع تحرك المحركات وناقلات الحركة والأسلاك والمقاعد والإلكترونيات ذهاباً وإياباً عبر الحدود.

segments.src: Key issues include:
segments.tr: تشمل القضايا الرئيسية:

segments.src: - **Rules of origin.** Under current rules, a vehicle generally must have 75% of its content from North America to qualify for duty-free treatment. A share of the work must also be done by workers earning at least $16 an hour. Governments may seek to raise these thresholds or add requirements for specific components such as steel, aluminum and batteries.
segments.tr: - **قواعد المنشأ.** بموجب القواعد الحالية، يجب أن تحتوي المركبة عموماً على 75% من محتواها من أمريكا الشمالية لتكون مؤهلة للمعاملة المعفاة من الرسوم الجمركية. يجب أيضاً أن يتم تنفيذ جزء من العمل بواسطة عمال يتقاضون ما لا يقل عن 16 دولاراً في الساعة. قد تسعى الحكومات إلى رفع هذه العتبات أو إضافة متطلبات لمكونات محددة مثل الصلب والألمنيوم والبطاريات.

segments.src: - **Non-North American content.** Washington has voiced concern about parts and materials from outside the region, especially from China, entering the supply chain through Mexico or Canada.
segments.tr: - **المحتوى غير القادم من أمريكا الشمالية.** أعربت واشنطن عن قلقها بشأن دخول أجزاء ومواد من خارج المنطقة، وخاصة من الصين، إلى سلسلة التوريد عبر المكسيك أو كندا.

segments.src: - **Tariffs outside the agreement.** Separate U.S. tariffs on autos, auto parts, steel and aluminum have complicated the picture. Automakers want clarity on how those measures interact with USMCA benefits.
segments.tr: - **التعريفات الجمركية خارج الاتفاقية.** أدت التعريفات الأمريكية المنفصلة على السيارات وقطع غيار السيارات والصلب والألمنيوم إلى تعقيد الصورة. يريد مصنعو السيارات توضيحاً حول كيفية تفاعل تلك الإجراءات مع مزايا USMCA.

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Automakers can absorb some added costs, pass them to buyers, or reshuffle production.
segments.tr: **ماذا يمكن أن يعني ذلك بالنسبة للأسعار:** يمكن لمصنعي السيارات استيعاب بعض التكاليف الإضافية، أو تمريرها إلى المشترين، أو إعادة ترتيب الإنتاج.

segments.src: Any of those choices can affect sticker prices, trim availability and used-car values.
segments.tr: أي من هذه الخيارات يمكن أن يؤثر على أسعار الملصقات، وتوافر الطرازات، وقيم السيارات المستعملة.

segments.src: Analysts often note that costs tied to tariffs or stricter origin rules tend to show up gradually rather than all at once.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يشير المحللون إلى أن التكاليف المرتبطة بالتعريفات الجمركية أو قواعد المنشأ الأكثر صرامة تميل إلى الظهور تدريجياً بدلاً من الظهور دفعة واحدة.

segments.src: ## Farms and Groceries
segments.tr: ## المزارع والبقالة

segments.src: Agriculture is another major area.
segments.tr: الزراعة هي مجال رئيسي آخر.

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: يبيع المزارعون الأمريكيون

segments.src: farmers sell large volumes of corn, soybeans, pork, beef, poultry and dairy to Mexico and Canada, while Americans buy fresh fruit, vegetables, avocados, tomatoes, beer and beef from them in return.

segments.src: Points of friction include:
segments.tr: تشمل نقاط الاحتكاك:

segments.src: - **Dairy.** U.S. producers have long argued that Canada's supply-management system limits their access to its market. Canada has defended that system as important to its own farmers.
segments.tr: - **منتجات الألبان.** لطالما جادل المنتجون الأمريكيون بأن نظام إدارة العرض في كندا يحد من وصولهم إلى سوقها. دافعت كندا عن هذا النظام باعتباره مهماً لمزارعيها.

segments.src: - **Biotech corn.** Mexico's policies on genetically engineered corn have been a flashpoint, and a dispute panel previously ruled on part of that issue.
segments.tr: - **الذرة المعدلة وراثياً.** كانت سياسات المكسيك بشأن الذرة المعدلة وراثياً نقطة اشتعال، وقد أصدرت لجنة نزاعات حكماً سابقاً بشأن جزء من تلك القضية.

segments.src: - **Seasonal produce.** Growers in some U.S. states say imports compete with them during certain months, while shoppers rely on those imports for year-round supply.
segments.tr: - **المنتجات الموسمية.** يقول المزارعون في بعض الولايات الأمريكية إن الواردات تنافسهم خلال أشهر معينة، بينما يعتمد المتسوقون على تلك الواردات لتوفير الإمدادات على مدار العام.

segments.src: **What it could mean for prices:** Because many fruits and vegetables are imported during the winter, higher tariffs or trade barriers could raise grocery costs or reduce choice in some categories.
segments.tr: **ماذا يمكن أن يعني ذلك بالنسبة للأسعار:** نظراً لأن العديد من الفواكه والخضروات يتم استيرادها خلال فصل الشتاء، فإن التعريفات الجمركية الأعلى أو الحواجز التجارية قد ترفع تكاليف البقالة أو تقلل الخيارات في بعض الفئات.

segments.src: ## Jobs and Factories
segments.tr: ## الوظائف والمصانع

segments.src: Manufacturing employment is a central argument on every side.
segments.tr: تعد عمالة التصنيع حجة مركزية من كل جانب.

segments.src: Supporters of tighter rules say stronger requirements can bring production and jobs to the United States and raise wages.
segments.tr: يقول مؤيدو القواعد الأكثر صرامة إن المتطلبات الأقوى يمكن أن تجلب الإنتاج والوظائف إلى الولايات المتحدة وترفع الأجور.

segments.src: Others caution that making cross-border supply chains more costly could reduce competitiveness against producers in Asia and Europe and put existing jobs at risk.
segments.tr: يحذر آخرون من أن جعل سلاسل التوريد عبر الحدود أكثر تكلفة قد يقلل من القدرة التنافسية ضد المنتجين في آسيا وأوروبا ويعرض الوظائف الحالية للخطر.

segments.src: Mexico has an interest in keeping its position as a major manufacturing hub and in attracting investment.
segments.tr: لدى المكسيك مصلحة في الحفاظ على مكانتها كمركز تصنيع رئيسي وفي جذب الاستثمار.

segments.src: Canada, which sends the large majority of its exports south, depends heavily on predictable access to the U.S.
segments.tr: تعتمد كندا، التي ترسل الغالبية العظمى من صادراتها جنوباً، بشكل كبير على الوصول المتوقع إلى السوق

segments.src: market.
segments.tr: الأمريكية.

segments.src: For many communities, a single plant can be a main employer, so decisions about where to invest are watched closely.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للعديد من المجتمعات، يمكن أن يكون مصنع واحد هو صاحب العمل الرئيسي، لذا تتم مراقبة القرارات المتعلقة بمكان الاستثمار عن كثب.

segments.src: ## Other Topics on the Table
segments.tr: ## مواضيع أخرى على الطاولة

segments.src: The review is not limited to cars and crops.
segments.tr: لا تقتصر المراجعة على السيارات والمحاصيل.

segments.src: Other issues that have come up include:
segments.tr: تشمل القضايا الأخرى التي ظهرت:

segments.src: - **Energy policy,** including the role of state-owned energy companies in Mexico.
segments.tr: - **سياسة الطاقة،** بما في ذلك دور شركات الطاقة المملوكة للدولة في المكسيك.

segments.src: - **Digital trade and online services,** including taxes and data rules.
segments.tr: - **التجارة الرقمية والخدمات عبر الإنترنت،** بما في ذلك الضرائب وقواعد البيانات.

segments.src: - **Labor standards,** such as enforcement of workers' rights in Mexican facilities.
segments.tr: - **معايير العمل،** مثل إنفاذ حقوق العمال في المنشآت المكسيكية.

segments.src: - **Dispute settlement,** and whether the process for resolving trade disagreements is fast and effective enough.
segments.tr: - **تسوية النزاعات،** وما إذا كانت عملية حل الخلافات التجارية سريعة وفعالة بما فيه الكفاية.

segments.src: - **Economic security,** including how to handle investment and imports from non-member countries.
segments.tr: - **الأمن الاقتصادي،** بما في ذلك كيفية التعامل مع الاستثمار والواردات من الدول غير الأعضاء.

segments.src: ## Why Businesses Are Bracing for Uncertainty
segments.tr: ## لماذا تستعد الشركات لعدم اليقين

segments.src: Companies make decisions years in advance.
segments.tr: تتخذ الشركات قراراتها قبل سنوات.

segments.src: Building or expanding a plant, signing supplier contracts and setting vehicle prices all depend on a stable set of rules.
segments.tr: بناء أو توسيع مصنع، وتوقيع عقود الموردين، وتحديد أسعار المركبات، كلها تعتمد على مجموعة مستقرة من القواعد.

segments.src: When the rules might change, firms tend to respond in familiar ways:
segments.tr: عندما تكون القواعد عرضة للتغيير، تميل الشركات إلى الاستجابة بطرق مألوفة:

segments.src: 1. **Delay major investments** until the outlook is clearer.
segments.tr: 1. **تأجيل الاستثمارات الكبرى** حتى تتضح الرؤية.

segments.src: 2. **Build up inventories** ahead of possible tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. **بناء المخزونات** قبل فرض تعريفات محتملة.

segments.src: 3. **Diversify suppliers** to reduce reliance on any single border crossing.
segments.tr: 3. **تنويع الموردين** لتقليل الاعتماد على أي معبر حدودي واحد.

segments.src: 4. **Add price adjustment clauses** to contracts.
segments.tr: 4. **إضافة بنود تعديل الأسعار** إلى العقود.

segments.src: These steps can themselves affect costs, even before any formal change takes place.
segments.tr: يمكن لهذه الخطوات بحد ذاتها أن تؤثر على التكاليف، حتى قبل حدوث أي تغيير رسمي.

segments.src: ## What Consumers and Workers Can Watch
segments.tr: ## ما يمكن للمستهلكين والعمال مراقبته

segments.src: You do not need to follow every negotiating session to understand the likely effects.
segments.tr: لا تحتاج إلى متابعة كل جلسة تفاوض لفهم الآثار المحتملة.

segments.src: A few practical signals can help:
segments.tr: يمكن أن تساعد بعض الإشارات العملية:

segments.src: - **Official announcements** from the U.S. Trade Representative, Canada's trade ministry and Mexico's Ministry of Economy.
segments.tr: - **الإعلانات الرسمية** من الممثل التجاري الأمريكي، ووزارة التجارة الكندية، ووزارة الاقتصاد المكسيكية.

segments.src: - **Automaker and supplier earnings calls,** where executives often discuss expected costs and production plans.
segments.tr: - **مكالمات أرباح شركات صناعة السيارات والموردين،** حيث يناقش المسؤولون التنفيذيون غالباً التكاليف المتوقعة وخطط الإنتاج.

segments.src: - **Monthly inflation data,** particularly categories such as new vehicles, food and household goods.
segments.tr: - **بيانات التضخم الشهرية،** لا سيما فئات مثل المركبات الجديدة والأغذية والسلع المنزلية.

segments.src: - **Industry groups** for farmers, manufacturers and retailers, which publish their own assessments.
segments.tr: - **المجموعات الصناعية** للمزارعين والمصنعين وتجار التجزئة، التي تنشر تقييماتها الخاصة.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The USMCA review is about more than diplomacy.
segments.tr: مراجعة اتفاقية USMCA تتعلق بأكثر من مجرد الدبلوماسية.

segments.src: It is a decision about how North American supply chains are governed, and that touches car prices, grocery bills and the jobs tied to cross-border trade.
segments.tr: إنه قرار بشأن كيفية إدارة سلاسل التوريد في أمريكا الشمالية، وهذا يمس أسعار السيارات وفواتير البقالة والوظائف المرتبطة بالتجارة عبر الحدود.

segments.src: The most likely outcomes range from a straightforward extension to a longer period of annual reviews and negotiated changes.
segments.tr: تتراوح النتائج الأكثر احتمالاً من تمديد مباشر إلى فترة أطول من المراجعات السنوية والتغييرات المتفاوض عليها.

segments.src: In every scenario, the details of the rules, not just the headlines, will determine who gains and who bears the costs.
segments.tr: في كل سيناريو، ستحدد تفاصيل القواعد، وليس العناوين الرئيسية فقط، من الذي يكسب ومن الذي يتحمل التكاليف.
